remainingTips: There are no rules about what you type. Describe what you want to do in your own words - be as creative or detailed as you want.
Have a question about the world or the game? Use the 'Ask the Narrator' command!
Can't remember the name of a character or place? Try writing '@' followed by the first few letters.
Stuck with no idea what to do next? Use the 'Ask the Narrator' command to ask for suggestions.
Worried about convincing someone? Try taking the conversation one line at a time.
Be ambitious and creative: Voyage rewards those who dream big!
How you phrase things matters: the game rewards you for stylish, clever actions.
Coordinate with party members in combat for powerful combined effects.
The world is your oyster: find and claim a place to call home.
Family is worth fighting for. Having a family in the game can lead to great stories.
You can attack multiple times per turn, and so can your allies.
Tell people your hopes and goals: you never know who may share your dreams.
Death is not always the end…
If there's something you want to do, go out and give it a try!
Try describing your actions in detail. They may not always work out the way you expect, but it will make things more interesting!
If you can't beat 'em, persuade 'em. Try convincing an enemy to come over to your side - or go over to theirs!
You can solve a problem any way you can think of: fight, bribe, trick, steal, befriend. The choice is yours.
You may spend a long time with your party members. Choose them wisely!
You can try to dodge, block and attack all in the same turn.
You can use items and take other actions in the same turn.
Skills are most likely to succeed when you use them as intended: in their natural domain.
Don't forget to stock up on items. Shops often have very powerful equipment for sale.
You can level up by taking almost any action, so feel free to play the game whatever way you want.
Don't forget to check in on your party members! Ask them how they're doing - and tell them how you feel!
Sometimes you can insta-kill enemies if you get creative with your inputs.
Party members can learn new skills and abilities as you progress through the story together.
Environmental conditions can add modifiers to your skill checks. Use the world to your advantage!
Tired of action and fighting? Look for a tavern or other gathering spot to socialize and start new relationships.
To prepare for a fight, try giving your party members orders to carry out in combat.
Social skills are very powerful. Persuasion can save a lot of lives.
Don't think you can win a fight? Try making a deal instead.
You don't have to do it all yourself, you know: hire people to do jobs for you!
Tired of traveling? Try learning how to fly or teleport or look for other forms of travel in the world.
There's nothing you can't do if you put your mind to it, from starting a revolution to founding your own country!
Turn order is determined by level and a random initiative value. Higher level characters tend to act first.
Characters without targets (like those that are buffing or healing) act before characters who are targeting enemies.
Multiple defensive effects stack multiplicatively. Layer your defenses!
Damage reduction scales with level difference, but has diminishing returns.
Different enemies can have different resistances, vulnerabilities, immunities or weaknesses, which will greatly affect the damage they take.
Try different damage types to discover enemies' weaknesses!
Healing actions use the same success level system as attacks - critical successes will heal for more.
Your equipment's damage bonus increases overall damage by 10% per point.
Equipped items with an armor stat reduce incoming damage linearly: 1000 armor grants 90% damage reduction.
Want a quest? Try asking an NPC about their problems!
Most places and characters you meet have secrets to uncover: get exploring!
Your Journal contains a wealth of information about the world's people, places and ideas.
Want to learn more about the world? Try reading books or watching television or other media!
Looking for cool gear? Don't forget to loot dead enemies and search areas where powerful items might be found!
Need some help fighting? Recruit NPCs to join your party! Anyone you meet can become an ally—if you can convince them to take your side.
Can't find the skill you want? Try asking NPCs about any new skill you can imagine. They just might be able to teach it to you.
You can unlock custom abilities when your character does new things in the game.
Need ideas about how to start your story off? Try feeding some basic concepts to the Background Generator and editing what you get back.
Don't forget to explore. Open up the map and try going to a new location.
Abilities give you bonuses to success and allow you to perform the actions they describe without ever needing any items.
The memory system remembers. Reference past events, people you've met, and places you've been - even from many turns ago!
Locations, NPCs, and quests generate dynamically based on your actions. Every playthrough creates unique content!
Don't quit after failure! Mistakes, setbacks and even death can lead to memorable stories.
Every action teaches you something. You gain XP from attempting things, not just succeeding at them.
If you don't know what to do, press the submit button to continue without an action.

Rillmark Carryback.name: Rillmark Carryback
Rillmark Carryback.description:
Rillmark Carryback — Cargo frames.

An alloy frame with replaceable composite pads, wide handholds, and attachment points visible from either side of a load. A carrier can agree the next grip with another worker before putting it down. Freight crews, market suppliers, and households moving awkward possessions are its natural users. Hire through a willing Helvyra supplier or order through Grit and Supply; fitting, intended load, and inspected condition determine cost. Replace damaged pads and inspect couplings after a hard landing. A workshop can warrant the fitted assembly it checked, while excluding an unassessed change to the load. A secondhand frame with fresh paint still needs inspection beneath the pads. Halvora's established load-rating judgment makes Refit Row an appropriate assessment context if she accepts the job. It neither reduces mass nor functions as a patient stretcher.

A light rigid frame distributes an awkward load across replaceable supports, with fittings chosen for the carrier and transport method. It is useful while flying, riding, or moving goods through a service passage. Buy or hire through cargo suppliers; ask Grit and Supply about stock and Refit Row about a used frame. Cost follows fitting, tested capacity, and condition. Inspect couplings after impacts. It organizes a load; it does not cancel mass, protect fragile cargo automatically, or make carrying an injured person safe without suitable equipment and judgment. [ Standard | Named-maker | Helvyra supplier ]

Dravon Burden-4.name: Dravon Burden-4
Dravon Burden-4.description:
Dravon Burden-4 — Cargo frames.

A squared frame with heavy wearing faces, plainly marked sections, and captive fittings that resist being misplaced during routine servicing. State stores and permitted commercial allocation can supply relevant workers in Quilrath; a replacement depends on the responsible provider's actual process. Its purchase or issue burden includes fitting and maintenance rather than a new universal citizen price. Balrath's established machinery remit provides an institutional maintenance context, not a guaranteed household callout. An outside buyer might encounter a retired or recovered unit through an indirect trader. Repair then requires a competent shop with suitable parts; no state warranty automatically follows it. A substituted pin can look convincing while fitting poorly under load. Competence can make this a good frame; its origin grants neither access nor suspicion-free travel.

A light rigid frame distributes an awkward load across replaceable supports, with fittings chosen for the carrier and transport method. It is useful while flying, riding, or moving goods through a service passage. Buy or hire through cargo suppliers; ask Grit and Supply about stock and Refit Row about a used frame. Cost follows fitting, tested capacity, and condition. Inspect couplings after impacts. It organizes a load; it does not cancel mass, protect fragile cargo automatically, or make carrying an injured person safe without suitable equipment and judgment. [ Standard | Restricted | Quilrath state stores ]

Contair Temper.name: Contair Temper
Contair Temper.description:
Contair Temper — Controlled delivery cases.

A smooth-sided case with replaceable liners, a recessed condition display, and handles clear of the lid seal. It helps a courier explain what the case measured while a sample, meal component, or clinical supply was inside. Buyers choose an approved liner and suitable sensing package for that particular job. Vexorath Exchange procurement and qualified service establish the initial support plan; lawful onward sales require the same attention to replacement parts. Rental costs include cleaning, power, inspection, and return. A manufacturer-backed repair would cover its own corrected fault under the agreed terms, not compensate every spoiled cargo claim. Sensor calibration and continuous coverage must be checked before relying on a record. A genuine shell with a substituted controller is a meaningful secondhand risk. No reading proves a culprit, unknown contaminant, or unrecorded journey.

A reusable case provides a controlled environment and a readable history of its own monitored conditions. Food sellers, sample couriers, and clinical suppliers choose different approved liners. Hire one for an order or buy a commonly supported model; cleaning, energy, liner replacement, and return arrangements belong in the quote. A damaged sensor requires inspection. Its record supports a conversation about handling; it neither identifies an unknown contaminant nor proves who caused a fault. Ordinary freight and controlled handoffs still apply. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Rillmark Longhold.name: Rillmark Longhold
Rillmark Longhold.description:
Rillmark Longhold — Controlled delivery cases.

A delivery case with removable corner guards, washable partitions, and a large external space for the carrier's handling notes. It favors food stalls and repeat commercial deliveries that need reliable cleaning and uncomplicated turnover. A Helvyra trader can quote purchase or hire with a defined return location; Dustfall orders depend on a real shipment. The price advantage comes from a narrower supported operating range, not immunity to failure. Routine service checks the seal, liner, power component, and condition indicator; specialized calibration may require sending the relevant assembly onward. A seller's return guarantee applies to the tested case at hand. Used units often lose their original partitions; an improvised divider must be checked before incompatible goods share the interior. It preserves suitable cargo within its operating limits and cannot restore spoiled stock.

A reusable case provides a controlled environment and a readable history of its own monitored conditions. Food sellers, sample couriers, and clinical suppliers choose different approved liners. Hire one for an order or buy a commonly supported model; cleaning, energy, liner replacement, and return arrangements belong in the quote. A damaged sensor requires inspection. Its record supports a conversation about handling; it neither identifies an unknown contaminant nor proves who caused a fault. Ordinary freight and controlled handoffs still apply. [ Standard | Named-maker | Helvyra supplier ]

Contair Clearwell.name: Contair Clearwell
Contair Clearwell.description:
Contair Clearwell — Water-system cartridges.

A treatment cartridge with a keyed housing, readable service cover, and diagnostic connection for specifically supported environmental systems. Building maintainers buy the correct version through a permitted environmental-equipment channel, then document the host system and required testing. The cost lies in approved media, fitting, and verification as well as the casing. Routine maintenance replaces exhausted media and checks seals; support for a product never authorizes access to restricted infrastructure. A warranty could address a manufacturing defect without promising that every unknown input becomes potable. In a used unit, genuine casing and copied service labels do not establish the condition of its contents. An actual sample and system assessment matter. It is not legally stocked in Quilrath and does not offer a disguised Contair service channel to Dravon.

A serviceable component for compatible local water-treatment equipment, with a visible service record and replaceable treatment media. Dustfall households can pool purchases through existing suppliers and have Pella Mox or an appropriately qualified maintainer assess compatibility. Cost includes consumables and testing, not merely the casing. Used cartridges require inspection before reuse. This is a component within a water system, not a bottle that makes every liquid drinkable, an inexhaustible supply, or a substitute for Dustfall's absent durable coastal network. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Avenfold Refill.name: Avenfold Refill
Avenfold Refill.description:
Avenfold Refill — Water-system cartridges.

An accessible cartridge housing for a defined set of small domestic systems, using replaceable media obtained from qualified suppliers. Broad grips and a clear opening direction help a maintainer service it without dismantling the surrounding cupboard. A household can request it through a domestic retailer or ask Mox Patchworks whether a suitable unit would solve the actual fault; Pella is an established civilian repair specialist, not a newly appointed franchise owner. The quote includes compatibility assessment, media, testing, and return work if agreed. The maker could warrant its housing while identifying a different supplier's responsibility for consumables. Refilled does not mean renewed indefinitely: worn seats or damaged closures retire the casing. A plausible but unsuitable media refill can fail without visible damage. This supports Dustfall's small systems without inventing a coastal network or water source.

Dustfall households can pool purchases through existing suppliers and have Pella Mox or an appropriately qualified maintainer assess compatibility. Contair Aperture.name: Contair Aperture
Contair Aperture.description:
Contair Aperture — Environmental work visors.

A visor with a replaceable viewing surface, removable sensor modules, and controls that remain legible without filling the user's view. A professional selects the conditions their authorized work requires, rather than buying a promise to detect everything. Purchase through the Exchange or a lawful specialist supplier includes fitting, calibration, and supported software or control service where applicable. Clean the sensor surfaces and recalibrate after relevant damage or replacement. Support covers documented modules; an unassessed aftermarket module may invalidate that module's performance claim without making the whole product magically inoperable. A used Aperture can have a pristine display attached to a damaged sensor. Compare readings with appropriate instruments rather than trusting the startup animation. It cannot reveal people through mountains, diagnose affinities, or pronounce an unexplored volcanic tube safe.

A configurable visor displays instrument readings for conditions its installed sensors can measure: dust, visibility, local heat, or a task-specific warning. Workshop and route versions have different fittings; Ashglass Market is a sensible shopping context. Buyers pay for appropriate sensors, calibration, and comfortable use over a shift. Clean exposed surfaces and replace damaged seals. The visor cannot see through terrain, certify an unexplored tube as safe, predict patrols, or reveal an affinity. A warning supports trained judgment rather than replacing it. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Emberseam Ashwatch.name: Emberseam Ashwatch
Emberseam Ashwatch.description:
Emberseam Ashwatch — Environmental work visors.

A visor built around a defined combination of dust, visibility, and local thermal-work readings. A dull-finished frame, replaceable edge padding, and controls usable in suitable work gloves favor a long shift over a glossy demonstration. Ashglass Market sellers fit the wearer and explain the intended tasks; the maker or qualified instrument service handles calibration. Its relative affordability comes from fewer supported configurations. Clean fine dust from the approved service surfaces and replace damaged seals before the next appropriate job. A retailer may offer a fitting adjustment as part of the sale; calibration and impact repair remain separately stated responsibilities. Counterfeits may copy the frame while omitting a functional sensor. A comparison test exposes that discrepancy; wearing an authentic unit still does not confer thermal immunity or permission to enter a restricted facility.

Emberseam Shiftwrap.name: Emberseam Shiftwrap
Emberseam Shiftwrap.description:
Emberseam Shiftwrap — Thermal workwear.

Oversleeves and an apron with removable contact layers, comfortable fastening, and a choice of lengths for different workstations. The cook who dislikes a heavy cuff and the maintainer reaching around a hot housing need different fittings. Order through Ashglass Market or commission a fitting through a willing maker; fabric, construction, intended task, and repair provision determine cost. Wash and inspect according to the particular materials, replace worn layers, and retire damage that reaches the supporting construction. Workmanship support covers a faulty seam, not use outside the garment's stated task envelope. A secondhand set can be economical after qualified assessment; scorch discoloration alone neither condemns nor clears it. The wearer can leave work and change into favorite ordinary clothes. This is industrial protection, not armor, a uniform of loyalty, or permission to stand in every vent.

Flexible protective workwear shields clothing and suitable body areas during defined thermal tasks. Sized and fitted for the individual, it belongs in kitchens, maintenance work, and the Red Forges rather than only in combat scenes. Buy standard pieces, commission a fit, or borrow an employer's maintained set. Seam condition and accumulated damage determine replacement. Protection has a task envelope: wearing it does not authorize entry into every geothermal space or turn the user immune to heat. Workers can choose lighter off-duty clothing afterward. [ Standard | Named-maker | Ashglass Market ]

Dravon Furnace-6.name: Dravon Furnace-6
Dravon Furnace-6.description:
Dravon Furnace-6 — Thermal workwear.

Institutional thermal oversleeves and apron sections with substantial closures, standardized replaceable panels, and plain size markings. Provision through the responsible work allocation or employer gives maintenance crews a familiar set across shifts; availability still follows actual permissions and stock. Cost is borne through that arrangement rather than a new planetary tariff. An issued panel must fit the specific model and wearer; a mechanic does not repair protective seams with whatever wire happens to be nearby. Defect handling returns damaged stock to the issuing provider for assessment, with a substitute only if one is available. Outside Quilrath, recovered workwear needs condition and fit checks before sale. A removed property marking does not prove lawful release. Its durable appearance should invite confidence only when the protective layers merit it; it is not an invented Redline combat suit.

Contair Workline.name: Contair Workline
Contair Workline.description:
Contair Workline — Repair rolls and readers.

A compact roll with individually replaceable precision tools and a reader that explains supported system messages in a usable sequence. A supervised trainee can begin with a small set; a professional adds appropriate authorized attachments. The Toolwright Gallery and Repair Contract Board provide established contexts for buying tools and finding competent service, without requiring a personal appointment with Rezulith. Cost rises with calibration, attachment scope, and actual support. Replace worn tips, inspect connectors, and keep the reader's applicable service information current. Warranties distinguish a failed instrument from damage caused during a repair. A copied case or misleading attachment label can promise compatibility the reader does not have. Verify it against the specific device before taking the customer's equipment apart. The Workline is not a gate credential, universal hacking key, or substitute for understanding the system.

A compact kit holds interchangeable tools, connectors, and a reader for systems the operator is authorized and equipped to service. A beginner buys a limited supported set; a workshop lends costly specialized attachments. Prices follow quality, calibration, and compatible parts. Clean tools, replace worn tips, and preserve readable repair notes. The reader can identify a reported fault without understanding its whole cause. It is not a hacking key, a Gate repair qualification, or permission to improvise around a safety interlock. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Emberseam Benchmate.name: Emberseam Benchmate
Emberseam Benchmate.description:
Emberseam Benchmate — Repair rolls and readers.

A repair roll with robust everyday tools, a limited reader, and pockets that remain recognizable after one is replaced. It belongs beside a thermal workshop bench and can travel to an ordinary building repair. Purchase individual tools or a fitted roll through an Ashglass seller; a Dustfall workshop might order replacements through a willing supplier rather than stock the entire range. The accessible initial cost reflects a deliberately limited diagnostic scope. Calibration, worn tool tips, and damaged leads remain real expenses. Support covers each supplied instrument on its stated terms; the roll can contain another maker's properly assessed tool without becoming a complete Emberseam-certified system. Counterfeit tips may deform on an ordinary fastener. A maintainer who lacks the correct tool stops or refers the job; their pride in practical equipment does not justify bypassing protection.

Contair Thread.name: Contair Thread
Contair Thread.description:
Contair Thread — Communication slates.

A personal slate with adjustable presentation, a comfortable edge grip, and a replaceable power assembly serviced through appropriate channels. It suits residents juggling appointments, conversations, teaching notes, and ordinary photographs or records they choose to retain. Buy a lawfully released model through a willing supplier after checking the local communication service. Cost reflects interface quality, condition, fitting accessories, and support. Repair terms explain whether a customer must preserve their own local data before a service procedure; the shop does not casually read a private life to test the screen. A used slate needs consensual removal of the prior owner's data and a functionality check, not an invented universal identity reset. A convincing casing can conceal poor power components. Sending a message does not prove receipt, convey official clearance, or teach everyone the sender's history.

A durable handheld or wearable interface keeps contacts, appointments, consented messages, and locally retained task notes accessible. A repaired unit is an ordinary purchase; comfort, privacy settings, service compatibility, and repair support matter more than spectacle. Replace degraded power components and inspect damaged cases. Communication depends on available infrastructure and actual relays. A message being composed or transmitted is not proof of receipt. The slate confers no extraterritorial identity clearance, automatic trust, or universal knowledge of another person's history. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Rillmark Waynote.name: Rillmark Waynote
Rillmark Waynote.description:
Rillmark Waynote — Communication slates.

A durable slate with a replaceable grip edge, a useful stand, and an easily visible distinction between a locally saved note and an acknowledged message. Freight workers can set it down beside a load without balancing it on a fragile corner. Procurement through a Helvyra supplier includes checking actual service compatibility; Grit and Supply could order or resell supported stock. Cost favors the case, handling, and serviceable components over elaborate display features. Clean contacts, inspect impact damage, and replace degraded power components with suitable stock. A seller's warranty covers the inspected unit rather than reception along every route. Used devices should be checked for damaged message controls and retained private records. The Waynote does not create a relay network, store everyone's secret route, or make a smuggler's communication untraceable. Operators still confirm the actual receiving person.

A durable handheld or wearable interface keeps contacts, appointments, consented messages, and locally retained task notes accessible. A repaired unit is an ordinary purchase; comfort, privacy settings, service compatibility, and repair support matter more than spectacle. Replace degraded power components and inspect damaged cases. Communication depends on available infrastructure and actual relays. A message being composed or transmitted is not proof of receipt. Contair Restline.name: Contair Restline
Contair Restline.description:
Contair Restline — Recovery seats.

An adjustable recovery seat with powered positioning, washable contact sections, and controls the user can reach or request assistance with. A professional selects supports and transfer arrangements with the person using it. Procurement through an appropriate medical or assistive-equipment provider includes fitting and a plan for maintenance where it will live; clinical authority remains with qualified practitioners, not the manufacturer. Cost includes assessment, adjustment, servicing, and suitable power support. Warranty work repairs equipment faults without promising a medical result. Inspect actuators, controls, restraints where appropriate, and contact surfaces; an attractive secondhand chair may be unsuitable for the new user's needs. No personal diagnosis travels with the object as public resale information. It supports choice, comfort, and recovery rather than diagnosing conditions or making every transfer safe. Contair origin does not require permanent residence in Vexorath.

An adjustable seat supports rest, assisted transfer, and a person's preferred position during recovery. Clinics can lend an appropriate model; households and employers can rent or purchase one with professional fitting. Cleaning, power support where required, moving it, and follow-up adjustment all cost labor. Users control comfort choices wherever feasible. The seat serves injured, recovering, disabled, tired, or otherwise assisted people without inventing a biological caste. It does not diagnose illness or make transport safe simply because it is technologically sophisticated. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Avenfold Ease.name: Avenfold Ease
Avenfold Ease.description:
Avenfold Ease — Recovery seats.

A domestic recovery seat with manually adjustable sections, removable cushions, and broad stable supports. It sacrifices some powered convenience for simpler servicing and a form someone might want in a shared sitting room. A household retailer can arrange a qualified fitting; a clinic or employer may purchase one to lend under a stated agreement. Price depends on fit, suitable contact materials, delivery, and continued adjustment rather than a claim that manual is always cheaper for every user. Workmanship support covers the frame and supplied fittings; a clinical follow-up is a distinct service. Check locking sections and worn supports before lending it again. A makeshift cushion can change a previously safe position. The Ease is not appropriate for every transfer, body, or recovery need. Choosing more sophisticated assistance is a practical choice, not dependence or failure.

An adjustable seat supports rest, assisted transfer, and a person's preferred position during recovery. Clinics can lend an appropriate model; households and employers can rent or purchase one with professional fitting. Contair Stillroom.name: Contair Stillroom
Contair Stillroom.description:
Contair Stillroom — Preservation drawers.

A compact drawer with separately controlled storage sections, accessible cleaning surfaces, and plain indications when a section has left its configured conditions. It suits a careful household, small restaurant, or shared kitchen that needs different ingredients kept apart. A lawful kitchen-equipment supplier quotes installation, supported power connection, sensor service, and capacity appropriate to actual use. Buyers pay for fine control and fitting; the model does not guarantee a professional kitchen's food safety simply by being installed. Clean seals and drains where applicable, verify sensors, and separate suspect food after a fault. The warranty addresses the appliance defect under the agreed terms; consequential stock losses need their own contract. A genuine exterior with an unassessed controller is a poor bargain. It preserves suitable ingredients and cannot reverse deterioration, replace sound handling, or become Contair infrastructure legally sold into Quilrath.

A modular food-storage unit keeps selected ingredients in their required conditions and separates incompatible storage needs. Shops sell domestic models; shared kitchens spread the cost of larger installations. Buying used is attractive when a maintainer can source its seals, sensors, and control components. Routine cleaning and honest labeling matter. Its service life is finite, and it cannot reverse spoiled food. It helps Dustfall vary meals between deliveries without removing shortage pressure or making every kitchen dependent on learned magic. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Avenfold Keep.name: Avenfold Keep
Avenfold Keep.description:
Avenfold Keep — Preservation drawers.

A domestic preservation drawer with fewer configurable sections, removable trays, and service access designed for a small kitchen. Households can choose a quiet finish or retain the panels from an older unit if the dimensions and attachments genuinely match. Buy through an existing domestic supplier or inspect one from Relstaris's Failed Kitchen Auction; an auction purchase does not inherit a new-unit warranty. Cost follows condition, seals, controls, installation, and the availability of supported replacements. A Dustfall household could ask Mox Patchworks about a suitable secondhand unit, without making Pella responsible for every Avenfold product. New-unit support can cover supplied parts and workmanship while charging separately for damaged installations. A fresh label over a failed temperature indicator is a verifiable defect. The drawer helps a household make good use of deliveries; it does not make those deliveries reliable.

A modular food-storage unit keeps selected ingredients in their required conditions and separates incompatible storage needs. Contair Measure.name: Contair Measure
Contair Measure.description:
Contair Measure — Portion-and-brew stations.

A countertop appliance with easy-clean food-contact assemblies, a legible portion control, and settings a brewer can deliberately adjust. A café uses it to repeat a regular's preference and still tastes what it serves. Commercial purchase or lease through a lawful supplier accounts for fitting, cleaning time, consumables, and service access, rather than an invented standard franchise fee. Maintenance arrangements identify who supplies worn valves, controls, and approved contact parts. A warranty might correct inconsistent operation after proper assessment; it does not promise that the customer will like every roast. A used unit needs a clean internal inspection as well as an attractive polish. Unsupported replacement parts can spoil repeatability or hygiene. The Measure is equipment, not a branded Cyrra recipe, and does not establish cross-species food or stimulant tolerance.

A countertop appliance supports repeatable preparation of Cyrra and other suitable drinks while leaving the brewer in control. A household unit, café lease, or refurbished kitchen purchase offers different capacity and maintenance burdens. Clean food-contact parts and check portion controls. A customer's favorite roast, strength, and Selka addition remain preferences rather than a canonical recipe. The machine cannot make stale ingredients excellent or know a visitor's biological tolerance. People can enjoy hand preparation without being technologically backward. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Avenfold Second Cup.name: Avenfold Second Cup
Avenfold Second Cup.description:
Avenfold Second Cup — Portion-and-brew stations.

A smaller station with a removable preparation assembly, plainly adjustable portions, and a counter footprint suited to a home or modest meeting room. A household can buy new, share the cost, or acquire a properly inspected used unit through existing kitchen resale. Its value is uncomplicated upkeep and an enjoyable daily ritual rather than serving a whole busy restaurant from one cheap appliance. Fit, contact materials, and wear determine the final cost. A return arrangement covers an identified defect; ordinary cleaning and replacement of worn parts remain the owner's agreed responsibilities. Check for residue in inaccessible surfaces and verify the controls after refurbishment. A café may use one for a limited service with an honest capacity plan. The name is a machine model, not a food brand, new ingredient, intoxicant category, or mandatory serving custom.

A countertop appliance supports repeatable preparation of Cyrra and other suitable drinks while leaving the brewer in control. A household unit, café lease, or refurbished kitchen purchase offers different capacity and maintenance burdens. Clean food-contact parts and check portion controls. A customer's favorite roast, strength, and Selka addition remain preferences rather than a canonical recipe. The machine cannot make stale ingredients excellent or know a visitor's biological tolerance. People can enjoy hand preparation without being technologically backward. Avenfold Foldroom.name: Avenfold Foldroom
Avenfold Foldroom.description:
Avenfold Foldroom — Household screens.

A folding divider with replaceable patterned panels, smooth hinges, and a stable base suitable for its intended floor. A nested set of washable containers, eating tools, serving pieces, and a carrier arranged so clean stock need not sit beside dirty returns. A stallholder can replace frequently lost pieces individually, provided the replacement truly fits the set. Fit the actual species, body and chosen specialty. Civilian personal equipment only: no skill, power, permit, privileged access, unlimited supply or premium capability. Preserve actual condition and custody. [ Basic | Common | Helvyra supplier ]

Standard training blade.name: Standard training blade
Standard training blade.description: A balanced practice sword with a blunted edge and weighted grip, standard issue at training facilities across Nexara. Designed for sparring and drill rather than lethal combat. Inspect edge condition, grip binding and balance before each session. Not a substitute for a live blade in actual confrontation. [ Training | Common | Academy issue ]

Wayline blade.name: Wayline blade
Wayline blade.description: A live sword made for the Corsair Wayline style — balanced for movement, timed exchanges and route-reading footwork. The blade profile favors responsive angle changes over raw force. Corsair instructors maintain that the blade must match the practitioner's reach and movement habits; a generic fit undermines the style. Requires actual trained competence. A Wayline blade in untrained hands is just a sword with an expensive lineage. [ Standard | Named-maker | Corsair Swordsmanship Branch ]

Veltrax pressure blade.name: Veltrax pressure blade
Veltrax pressure blade.description: A live sword built for the Veltrax pressure style — heavier forward balance for committed exchanges, pursuit cuts and rhythm-breaking entries. House Veltrax marks their blades with a red forward-pointing mark inside a broken circle. The style demands aggression and physical conditioning; the blade punishes hesitation. Acquisition through House Veltrax channels or secondhand from a verified source. Carrying a Veltrax-marked blade implies willingness to accept a challenge. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | House Veltrax ]

Ordinary personal blade.name: Ordinary personal blade
Ordinary personal blade.description: A serviceable personal sword or long knife without a school lineage or house mark. Practical construction from standard materials, maintained by the owner or a local smith. Common among travelers, independent contractors, and frontier residents who need a reliable edged weapon without the social weight of a house-marked blade. Quality varies with maker and maintenance. Inspect edge, tang, and grip before relying on it. [ Standard | Common | Helvyra supplier ]

Starian plasma revolver.name: Starian plasma revolver
Starian plasma revolver.description: A plasma-based sidearm common across Nexara, particularly on the frontier. Compact rotating cylinder design with a vented barrel for heat management. Effective at close to medium range. Ammunition is a sealed plasma cartridge; spent cartridges must be replaced, not recharged in the field. Legal in most cities with a standard carry permit; restricted in Solvraxis, where all weapons must be surrendered at entry checkpoints. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Standard | Uncommon | Grit and Supply ]

Contair-pattern rifle.name: Contair-pattern rifle
Contair-pattern rifle.description: A precision long-range weapon manufactured to Contair engineering standards. Reliable, accurate, and built for sustained use with minimal maintenance. The standard against which other manufacturers' rifles are measured. Sol-modified variants with unauthorized field adjustments are common on the frontier and may perform differently from factory specification. Ammunition and replacement parts follow Contair's proprietary format. Cost reflects the engineering; cheaper alternatives exist but are not this. Damage type: energy (wounds Starians). [ Reinforced | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Old hand cannon.name: Old hand cannon
Old hand cannon.description: A heavy-caliber sidearm with manual cycling — an archaic design still common on the frontier where reliability matters more than rate of fire. Mechanically simple, easy to repair with basic tools, and devastating at close range. The cycling mechanism is loud and the recoil is substantial; this is not a weapon for subtlety. Frontier gunsmiths keep these running with salvaged parts and improvised solutions. Damage type: heavy-ballistic (large caliber; pierces Starian skin). [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Sol-modified sidearm.name: Sol-modified sidearm
Sol-modified sidearm.description: A standard-pattern weapon with House Sol field modifications — typically improved targeting, rebalanced power output, or adapted grip geometry. Sol modifications are unauthorized by the original manufacturer and void any warranty. Performance may exceed factory spec in specific conditions but can be unpredictable outside those conditions. A Sol-modified weapon is a personal tool, not a production model. Common in Dustfall and frontier settlements where Sol's practical engineering culture thrives. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Practical staff.name: Practical staff
Practical staff.description: A solid staff suitable for walking, balance support, and defensive use. Common among travelers, affinity practitioners who use it as a focus aid, and anyone who prefers reach over edge weapons. A staff is not restricted in Solvraxis's weapon-free zone if it is clearly a walking aid. Combat use requires actual practice; a long stick in untrained hands is a liability. [ Basic | Common | Helvyra supplier ]

Reinforced helmet.name: Reinforced helmet
Reinforced helmet.description: A fitted head protector with impact-absorbing liner and adjustable retention. Standard protective equipment for security work, industrial environments, and light combat. Peripheral vision is slightly reduced. Check fit and liner condition regularly; an ill-fitting helmet is worse than none. [ Reinforced | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Padded leg guards.name: Padded leg guards
Padded leg guards.description: Knee-to-shin protective guards with flexible backing and reinforced strike plates. Common in training facilities, industrial work, and fieldwork where leg injuries are a regular hazard. Compatible with most clothing and footwear. The padding absorbs moderate impact but is not rated for heavy weapon strikes. [ Standard | Common | Academy issue ]

Frontier armor plate.name: Frontier armor plate
Frontier armor plate.description: Patched and repaired body armor common in Dustfall and frontier settlements. Original manufacture varies — some plates are salvaged military, others are cobbled from industrial shielding. Frontier armorers repair and refit what's available. Protection is real but inconsistent; coverage depends on what patches are still attached and which impacts the plate has already absorbed. Inspect thoroughly before trusting it. [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Armor-cloth vest.name: Armor-cloth vest
Armor-cloth vest.description: A flexible vest made from armor-cloth — a textile material reinforced through a combination of advanced weaving and, in better examples, affinity-based fiber tensioning. Lighter and less conspicuous than plate armor but offers less raw protection. Favored by people who need protection without looking like they expect a fight. Repair requires someone who understands the material; standard tailoring may compromise the weave. [ Standard | Uncommon | Quiet Thread, Dustfall ]

Flight-safe holster rig.name: Flight-safe holster rig
Flight-safe holster rig.description: A torso harness designed for Starian aerial use — weapon retention during flight, quick-draw access on landing, and load distribution across the chest and back without restricting the shoulders or back in flight. Includes secondary retention straps that engage during steep maneuvers. Species-specific: designed for Starian flight posture. Other species may wear it as a standard chest rig but the flight features are nonfunctional. [ Basic | Common | Korrvane ]

Tournament-approved wraps.name: Tournament-approved wraps
Tournament-approved wraps.description: Hand and wrist wraps meeting Korrvane tournament regulations. Provide moderate impact protection for striking and grappling while remaining within competition rules. Sold at the Fight-Day Market and sanctioned equipment vendors. Not a substitute for proper technique; wraps protect the hands, not the fighter. [ Basic | Common | Fight-Day Market, Korrvane ]

Emergency field kit.name: Emergency field kit
Emergency field kit.description: A compact medical kit for frontier and field use — wound closure strips, antiseptic solution, pain management supplies, a splinting material, and basic diagnostic tools. One kit handles one serious injury or several minor ones. Not a hospital. Cannot treat affinity burnout, major surgery, or species-specific conditions. Common in Dustfall and carried by contractors working outside city medical coverage. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Inscription renewal supplies.name: Inscription renewal supplies
Inscription renewal supplies.description: Materials for maintaining and renewing existing inscription-craft workings: marking compounds, stabilizing solutions, and reference templates. Inscription decays over time and requires periodic renewal by a competent practitioner. These supplies support renewal of one existing working at ordinary complexity. The practitioner's skill and the working's original quality determine the result, not the supplies alone. [ Standard | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Preservation seal components.name: Preservation seal components
Preservation seal components.description: Materials for preparing one preservation seal — the most common commercial inscription on Nexara, used to extend the life of perishable goods during storage and transit. Requires a trained inscription practitioner to apply. The seal is a working, not a permanent enchantment; it decays and must be renewed on schedule. Standard trade item at the Grand Market, Routefall Market, and most commercial districts. [ Standard | Common | Routefall Market ]

Plasma cartridge pack.name: Plasma cartridge pack
Plasma cartridge pack.description: A sealed pack of standard-format plasma cartridges compatible with common Nexaran sidearms. Each cartridge is a self-contained charge; spent cartridges are waste, not rechargeable. Store away from heat and impact. Damaged or swollen cartridges must be disposed of safely. Cost and availability vary by city; frontier settlements charge a premium. Dravon-manufactured cartridges exist but may not meet Contair tolerances. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Route-charm.name: Route-charm
Route-charm.description: A small inscription-craft working that aids navigation and route-finding. Commonly purchased from certified practitioners at the Routefall Market or Trade Arcade. The charm references known landmarks and route markers; it does not reveal hidden paths or function in areas without established navigation infrastructure. Decays after a limited period — charms are 'a subscription, not a purchase.' Open Circle certification marks indicate quality and reliability. [ Standard | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Ward-mark patch.name: Ward-mark patch
Ward-mark patch.description: A prepared protective inscription on a portable medium — typically a treated fabric patch or metal plate — that can be applied to a container, doorframe, or surface. Provides modest protection against a single defined threat type for a limited duration. The ward's scope is set at preparation; a fire-ward does not protect against water damage. Requires no skill to apply but a practitioner to prepare and renew. [ Standard | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Ammunition converter.name: Ammunition converter
Ammunition converter.description: A small adapter device that converts ammunition between formats — allowing weapons of one standard to fire cartridges from another. Common frontier equipment where ammunition supply is inconsistent. Each converter is format-specific and handles a limited number of conversions before the adapter wears. Conversion may affect accuracy, power output, or reliability. Not a permanent solution. [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Recovery supplies.name: Recovery supplies
Recovery supplies.description: Post-exertion recovery materials: muscle treatment compounds, hydration concentrates, cooling wraps, and nutritional supplements. Standard after heavy training, tournament competition, or sustained physical labor. One pack supports recovery from one session of intense activity. Does not accelerate healing from actual injury — see a medic for that. [ Basic | Common | Korrvane Recovery Yards ]

Weapon maintenance kit.name: Weapon maintenance kit
Weapon maintenance kit.description: Cleaning, sharpening, and basic repair supplies for personal weapons. Includes edge-honing tools, lubricants, barrel cleaning rods, grip wrapping material, and a condition assessment guide. Maintains existing weapons; does not upgrade or modify them. A weapon kept clean and properly maintained lasts longer and performs more reliably. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Analysis slate.name: Analysis slate
Analysis slate.description: A portable computing surface used for recording observations, running basic calculations, and displaying reference data. Popular with tournament analysts in Korrvane, researchers in Solvraxis, and traders tracking market movements. Not a general-purpose computer — it runs specific installed applications and has limited connectivity outside supported infrastructure. [ Standard | Common | Vexorath Exchange ]

Common Scale seal stamp.name: Common Scale seal stamp
Common Scale seal stamp.description: A stamp tool for applying the Common Scale seal — the standard trade authentication mark on Nexara. Used by licensed merchants to certify weights, measures, and cargo grades. The seal is also described as 'the most forged object on Nexara,' so a legitimate stamp carries its own verification features. Carrying one without a merchant license raises questions. [ Standard | Restricted | Common Scale, Helvyra ]

Forge hand-tools.name: Forge hand-tools
Forge hand-tools.description: A portable set of metalworking hand-tools — hammer, tongs, files, and measuring instruments. Sufficient for basic repair and finishing work away from a full forge. Not a substitute for the Red Forges' heavy equipment; these handle maintenance, field repair, and small-scale fabrication. Quality matters — cheap tools damage workpieces. Ignivex-made tools command a premium for good reason. [ Standard | Common | Red Forges, Ignivex ]

Unstable recoil dampener.name: Unstable recoil dampener
Unstable recoil dampener.description: A frontier-grade recoil modification that reduces weapon kickback — effective when it works, unpredictable when it doesn't. Common Dustfall equipment, typically scavenged or improvised. Attach to a compatible weapon's receiver. May need recalibration after heavy use. If the dampener starts heating during fire, stop immediately. Not sold by any reputable manufacturer for good reason. [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Capture restraint set.name: Capture restraint set
Capture restraint set.description: Restraint equipment for securing an uncooperative person or creature: binding cuffs, limb restraints, and a portable frame. Used by bounty hunters, security personnel, and law enforcement. Carrying restraint equipment in most cities is legal for licensed contractors; unlicensed possession draws official attention. Restraining someone without legal authority is a crime regardless of equipment. [ Standard | Restricted | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Cargo ward marker.name: Cargo ward marker
Cargo ward marker.description: A reusable mounting frame for applying inscription-craft cargo wards to shipping containers. The frame positions the ward-mark correctly; the inscription itself must be prepared separately. Standard equipment for trade house logistics workers and independent shipping contractors. A marker without a prepared ward is just an empty frame. [ Standard | Common | Corsair Waypoint ]

Wayline principles handbook.name: Wayline principles handbook
Wayline principles handbook.description: A printed instructional text covering the publicly shared principles of the Corsair Wayline sword style. Covers stance, movement theory, and basic exchange patterns. The restricted advanced curriculum is not included — Corsair instructors protect the parts of the style their branch does not share publicly. Available at booksellers near training facilities. Not a substitute for instruction. [ Basic | Named-maker | Helvyra booksellers ]
Wayline principles handbook.mediaContent:
WAYLINE PRINCIPLES — Public Curriculum Edition

The Wayline style reads the space between fighters as a route, not a line. Distance, timing, and angle are resources to be managed, not obstacles to overcome.

Foundation: The practitioner moves first. Response follows the route already established, not the opponent's last action.

Principle of Adaptive Distance: Maintain the range where your blade works and theirs doesn't. When the route closes, change it.

Principle of Committed Exchange: Enter an exchange only when the route favors your blade. If it doesn't, move. Moving is not retreating.

Principle of Route-Reading: Every opponent reveals their next route before they take it. Watch the feet, not the blade.

Advanced material restricted by the Corsair Swordsmanship Branch. Seek instruction at an authorized school.

Republic civic reference.name: Republic civic reference
Republic civic reference.description: A compact reference guide to Starian Republic civic structure, laws, and citizen rights. Covers the Capitol Accord, civic dispute resolution, inter-house legal standing, and basic information about each Great House's governance model. Published by the Public Record Archive in Relstaris. Free at most government offices; purchased copies are available at booksellers. [ Basic | Common | Public Record Archive, Relstaris ]
Republic civic reference.mediaContent:
THE STARIAN REPUBLIC — A Citizen's Reference

Published by the Public Record Archive, Relstaris.

THE CAPITOL ACCORD establishes Relstaris as neutral ground. No single Great House may claim territorial sovereignty within city limits. Every citizen enjoys baseline rights regardless of house affiliation, species, or origin.

YOUR RIGHTS: Free movement through the Grand Lunar Gate Hub. Access to Capitol Service employment. Equal standing before the Arbitration Court. Medical care at Myralis Capitol Clinic (subsidized for citizens).

THE GREAT HOUSES: Castro (education, Solvraxis), Genesis (research, Korrvane), Contair (engineering, Vexorath), Corsair (trade, Helvyra), Volen (industry, Ignivex), Dravon (military, Quilrath — currently under separate authority).

DISPUTES: File through the Arbitration Court in the Public Protection District. Inter-house matters may be escalated to the rotating council in High Relstaris.

This guide does not constitute legal advice.

Frontier customs guide.name: Frontier customs guide
Frontier customs guide.description: A hand-copied pamphlet circulating in Dustfall that lists the settlement's thirteen unwritten customs. No official publisher — the text is passed between newcomers as an informal orientation. Some copies include personal annotations from previous owners. The customs are not law; they are enforced through social pressure and reputation. [ Frontier | Common | Dustfall ]
Frontier customs guide.mediaContent:
DUSTFALL CUSTOMS — Hand to the next new face

1. Honor your debts.
2. Don't steal from those who share.
3. Defend your neighbors without being asked.
4. Mind your own business unless invited in.
5. The first claim stands.
6. A handshake is a contract.
7. Don't bring house politics to the frontier.
8. Everyone works or everyone knows.
9. The gate is for everyone.
10. Water is never wasted.
11. Strangers get one meal free.
12. What happens in the dust stays in the dust.
13. Never cross the Last Line Company.

Nobody wrote these down first. They wrote themselves. Break one and see how fast the dust remembers.

Quilrath access card — visitor.name: Quilrath access card — visitor
Quilrath access card — visitor.description: An issued visitor-grade access credential for Quilrath, granting Level 1 access and Grade 3 civic standing. Permits movement in designated public areas of the Gray Rings only. All movements are logged. The card must be carried at all times within Quilrath; failure to present it on request results in immediate detention. Issued at Quilrath's entry checkpoint and must be returned on departure. [ Basic | Restricted | Quilrath entry checkpoint ]
Quilrath access card — visitor.mediaContent:
QUILRATH VISITOR CREDENTIAL

ACCESS LEVEL: 1
CIVIC STANDING: 3 (Probationary)
VALID ZONES: Gray Ring public areas only

CONDITIONS OF ENTRY:
- Carry this credential at all times
- Present on request to any authorized official
- Do not enter restricted zones
- Do not photograph or record government facilities
- Report to exit checkpoint before credential expiry

FAILURE TO COMPLY RESULTS IN DETENTION AND CREDENTIAL REVOCATION.

Issued under the authority of the Balrath Administrative Complex.

Yalven weapon modification.name: Yalven weapon modification
Yalven weapon modification.description: A premium weapon modification produced by House Yalven's Forgeworks in Helvyra. Yalven modifications are precision-engineered to improve a specific weapon's performance characteristic — balance, heat dissipation, grip geometry, or firing mechanism. Each modification is fitted to a specific weapon and cannot be transferred casually. Yalven inspection seals appear on the modification's housing. Cost reflects the specialist labor; Yalven does not produce cheap work. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Truehand ]

Bolt n Break frontier mod.name: Bolt n Break frontier mod
Bolt n Break frontier mod.description: A weapon modification from Korrik Caelthorn's 'Bolt n Break' workshop on Dustfall's Refit Row. Frontier modifications that 'work brilliantly until they do not.' Performance may exceed factory specification in specific conditions but carries inherent risk. No warranty, no return policy, no manufacturer's support. Test at the Test-Fire Barrier before live use. If it starts making a sound it didn't make before, stop using it. [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Contair-compatible replacement parts.name: Contair-compatible replacement parts
Contair-compatible replacement parts.description: Replacement components manufactured to Contair specifications — or claiming to be. Legitimate parts carry Contair verification stamps; counterfeit versions circulate widely, especially on the frontier. A counterfeit part may function adequately or fail at the worst moment. The Vexorath Verification Desk at Relstaris Grand Market confirms legitimate standards. Dustfall's Dravon Component Bin sells openly acknowledged inferior alternatives at lower cost. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Vexorath Verification Desk ]

Varriko witness seal.name: Varriko witness seal
Varriko witness seal.description: A certification document bearing House Varriko's silver ledger seal crossed by two balance-lines. Varriko Witness Seals authenticate contracts, verify identities, and certify transactions. The seal is recognized across Nexara as a reliable third-party verification. Obtaining a false Varriko seal is possible but extremely risky — House Varriko's Trade Audit Room investigates irregularities aggressively. [ Standard | Named-maker | House Varriko, Helvyra ]
Varriko witness seal.mediaContent:
VARRIKO WITNESS SEAL — AUTHENTICATED DOCUMENT

This seal certifies that the attached document or transaction has been witnessed and verified by a licensed Varriko assessor.

Seal number: [UNIQUE]
Issuing office: Varriko Witness Seal Office, Helvyra

Tampering with, forging, or misrepresenting a Varriko seal constitutes fraud under Republic commercial law and is subject to prosecution through the Arbitration Court.

Verification: Present at any Varriko Trade Office for confirmation.

Dravon-manufactured utility gear.name: Dravon-manufactured utility gear
Dravon-manufactured utility gear.description: Standard-issue utility equipment manufactured in Quilrath under Dravon's state production system. Functional but widely regarded as inferior to Contair standards — adequate materials, acceptable tolerances, predictable performance without distinction. Available at Quilrath Equipment Row in the Relstaris Grand Market, where it sells on price and availability rather than quality. Frontier settlements use it when nothing better is available. [ Standard | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Salvaged drone components.name: Salvaged drone components
Salvaged drone components.description: Recovered components from decommissioned, damaged, or abandoned drones — sensors, actuators, power cells, and structural elements. Original manufacture varies; identification requires technical knowledge. Value depends on condition, compatibility, and what the buyer needs. Common trade goods in Dustfall's Bone Yard and the Vein Market. Military-grade components carry legal restrictions in Republic territory. [ Frontier | Uncommon | Bone Yard, Dustfall ]

Xelaphis — Deep-City Layers.name: Xelaphis — Deep-City Layers
Xelaphis — Deep-City Layers.description:
Xelaphis — Deep-City Layers.

Insulated, moisture-wicking layers designed for the constant cool humidity of Xelaphis's subterranean environment. Fabrics reflect bioluminescent light for visibility in low-light corridors. Cut allows freedom of movement in the three-dimensional architecture where climbing and ducking are routine. Surface-dweller clothing tends to be uncomfortable underground; deep-city layers solve the temperature and moisture problems. [ Standard | Uncommon | Xelaphis ]

Nexara — Fieldwork Layers.name: Nexara — Fieldwork Layers
Nexara — Fieldwork Layers.description:
Nexara — Fieldwork Layers.

Durable, practical clothing designed for outdoor work, field research, and sustained activity in varied terrain. Reinforced at stress points, fitted with utility pockets, and compatible with protective gear. Not fashion — function. These are what contractors, field researchers, and frontier workers wear when the job matters more than the look. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Nexara — Medical Professional.name: Nexara — Medical Professional
Nexara — Medical Professional.description:
Nexara — Medical Professional.

Clean, fitted clinical clothing suitable for healthcare environments. Antimicrobial treatment, fluid-resistant outer layer, and identifiable coloring per facility standards. Myralis clinic staff wear standardized versions; independent practitioners choose their own within professional norms. The clothing signals competence and hygiene before the wearer speaks. [ Standard | Uncommon | Myralis clinic supply ]

Dravon discipline blade.name: Dravon discipline blade
Dravon discipline blade.description: A sword forged to Dravon defensive specifications — weighted for parrying, with a wide guard and a blade geometry that rewards patience over aggression. Supplied through Dravon garrison channels. [ Standard | Restricted | Dravon garrison issue ]

Castro restraint blade.name: Castro restraint blade
Castro restraint blade.description: A sword designed for the Castro and Valcoro restraint tradition — shorter blade, weighted pommel, and a guard that facilitates controlled holds. Purpose-built for subduing rather than killing. [ Standard | Named-maker | House Castro ]

Frontier salvage blade.name: Frontier salvage blade
Frontier salvage blade.description: A serviceable sword assembled from salvaged alloy stock in a Dustfall workshop. No house mark, no pedigree, but the edge holds and the balance works for anyone who can swing it. [ Frontier | Common | Refit Row salvage ]

House-forged blade.name: House-forged blade
House-forged blade.description: A sword produced by a recognised house forge to inherited specifications — consistent metallurgy, fitted grip, and a maker's mark that means something in the right circles. A step above frontier work. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Masterwork blade.name: Masterwork blade
Masterwork blade.description: An exceptional sword produced by a master-rated smith — balance, edge geometry, and material quality at the practical ceiling of the craft. The kind of weapon that outlasts its owner. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Standard issue sidearm.name: Standard issue sidearm
Standard issue sidearm.description: A basic plasma sidearm common to security details, civic patrols, and issued positions across Nexara. Reliable, underpowered, and designed for deterrence over sustained firefights. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Basic | Restricted | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Frontier scatter-gun.name: Frontier scatter-gun
Frontier scatter-gun.description: A wide-bore plasma weapon common in Dustfall and frontier settlements. Short range, heavy spread, devastating in confined spaces. Maintenance is forgiving; accuracy is not. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Frontier | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Corsair quickdraw piece.name: Corsair quickdraw piece
Corsair quickdraw piece.description: A compact plasma sidearm modified for the Corsair emphasis on movement — reduced draw weight, shortened barrel, and a grip profile that clears a holster fast. Accuracy trades for speed. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Standard | Named-maker | Corsair Cache, Korrvane ]

Precision marksman rifle.name: Precision marksman rifle
Precision marksman rifle.description: A long-range plasma rifle built to marksman specifications — stabilised barrel, magnified optics, and a tuned power cell that trades rate of fire for consistent long-distance impact. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Masterwork | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Genesis heavy pistol.name: Genesis heavy pistol
Genesis heavy pistol.description: A high-output sidearm from the Genesis and Orvantis tradition — built heavier, kicks harder, and puts more energy into each shot than standard sidearms. Wrist strength is not optional. Damage type: energy (wounds Starians). [ Reinforced | Named-maker | House Genesis ]

Masterwork precision rifle.name: Masterwork precision rifle
Masterwork precision rifle.description: An exceptional long-range weapon produced to the highest manufacturing standard available on Nexara. Every component is fitted, tuned, and tested to tolerances that mass production cannot match. Damage type: energy (wounds Starians). [ Masterwork | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Training staff.name: Training staff
Training staff.description: A weighted practice staff padded at both ends for supervised training. Impact is dulled, weight is educational, and the design ensures nobody gets seriously hurt while learning the basics. [ Training | Common | Academy issue ]

Reinforced combat staff.name: Reinforced combat staff
Reinforced combat staff.description: A hardened alloy staff built for actual combat — weighted for striking, balanced for blocking, and strong enough to take the kind of abuse a wooden staff would not survive. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Channeling staff.name: Channeling staff
Channeling staff.description: A staff constructed with resonance-compatible materials that facilitate channeled magical workings. The combat weight is modest; the value is in the material, not the impact. [ Standard | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Ironwood quarterstaff.name: Ironwood quarterstaff
Ironwood quarterstaff.description: A dense ironwood staff harvested and cured in the traditional manner. Heavy, resilient, and well-suited to defensive staff work where absorbing force matters more than speed. [ Reinforced | Common | Helvyra supplier ]

Masterwork resonant staff.name: Masterwork resonant staff
Masterwork resonant staff.description: An exceptional staff constructed from layered resonance-compatible alloys by a specialist fabricator. Carries impact effectively and supports channeled work without degradation. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Fabrication Yards ]

Utility knife.name: Utility knife
Utility knife.description: A common-pattern folding knife carried by most frontier residents as a tool first and a weapon second. Adequate for cutting tasks; limited in a dedicated fight. [ Basic | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Belt knife.name: Belt knife
Belt knife.description: A fixed-blade personal knife worn at the waist — common throughout Nexara as everyday carry. Better balanced for defensive use than a utility folder but still a secondary weapon. [ Basic | Common | Helvyra supplier ]

Fighting knife.name: Fighting knife
Fighting knife.description: A purpose-built combat knife with a guard, a committed edge, and a grip designed for retention under pressure. Not a tool; a weapon carried with intent. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Frontier skinning blade.name: Frontier skinning blade
Frontier skinning blade.description: A wide-bellied knife designed for field work — skinning, dressing, and material processing. Effective in a fight at close range, but the edge profile favours slicing over thrusting. [ Frontier | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Masterwork combat knife.name: Masterwork combat knife
Masterwork combat knife.description: An exceptional fighting knife from a specialist bladesmith — perfect edge geometry, fitted grip, and a balance that makes the blade feel like an extension of the hand. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Work mallet.name: Work mallet
Work mallet.description: A heavy-headed mallet used in construction, metalwork, and demolition. Effective as a weapon in the way that any heavy tool is — crude but undeniable. [ Basic | Common | Red Forges, Ignivex ]

Weighted baton.name: Weighted baton
Weighted baton.description: A balanced striking baton carried by civic security and authorised enforcement personnel. Designed for controlled force application — deterrence and compliance, not lethal combat. [ Standard | Restricted | Relstaris civic issue ]

Frontier hammer.name: Frontier hammer
Frontier hammer.description: A heavy-headed hammer common among frontier workers and settlers who need a tool that doubles as personal protection. Simple, durable, and effective at close range. [ Frontier | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Masterwork warhammer.name: Masterwork warhammer
Masterwork warhammer.description: An exceptional combat hammer forged to inherited martial specifications — balance, head geometry, and shaft construction all optimised for delivering maximum impact with control. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Red Forges, Ignivex ]

Balanced throwing knives.name: Balanced throwing knives
Balanced throwing knives.description: A matched set of purpose-weighted throwing knives in a belt carrier. Factory-balanced to spin consistently at standard combat distances. Finite supply; retrieval is the user's problem. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Frontier throwing tools.name: Frontier throwing tools
Frontier throwing tools.description: Weighted objects — bolts, slugs, and shaped scrap — selected and carried specifically for throwing. Common among frontier residents who cannot afford dedicated weapons. [ Frontier | Common | Refit Row salvage ]

Masterwork throwing set.name: Masterwork throwing set
Masterwork throwing set.description: An exceptional set of precision-balanced throwing implements from a specialist fabricator — consistent weight, predictable flight, and fitted carrying harness. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Fabrication Yards ]

Practice bow.name: Practice bow
Practice bow.description: A low-draw training bow used in recreational and introductory archery. Safe enough for supervised practice, underpowered for hunting or combat. [ Training | Common | Academy issue ]

Hunting bow.name: Hunting bow
Hunting bow.description: A practical field bow with sufficient draw weight for game and moderate range. Common among frontier hunters and rural communities where ammunition supply is unreliable. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Composite field bow.name: Composite field bow
Composite field bow.description: A layered composite bow built for field use — higher draw weight, better performance in variable weather, and effective at ranges that simple bows cannot reach. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Helvyra supplier ]

Masterwork longbow.name: Masterwork longbow
Masterwork longbow.description: An exceptional longbow crafted by a specialist bowyer — optimal draw, consistent release, and material quality that translates every grain of the archer's strength into range and impact. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Standard impact gloves.name: Standard impact gloves
Standard impact gloves.description: Reinforced gloves with powered impact amplification — a basic augmentation common in industrial and security applications. The gloves increase striking force within the frame's rated capacity. [ Basic | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Reinforced strike gloves.name: Reinforced strike gloves
Reinforced strike gloves.description: Combat-rated powered gloves with improved force amplification and impact distribution. A step above industrial standard; designed for sustained close-quarters use. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Contair precision gauntlets.name: Contair precision gauntlets
Contair precision gauntlets.description: Assisted combat gloves manufactured to Contair engineering standards — precise force scaling, responsive activation, and diagnostics that report remaining charge and component wear. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Masterwork power gauntlets.name: Masterwork power gauntlets
Masterwork power gauntlets.description: Exceptional powered gauntlets built to the highest available specification — maximum force amplification, reinforced knuckle geometry, and a power system that sustains peak output longer than standard models. [ Masterwork | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Grip wraps.name: Grip wraps
Grip wraps.description: Padded hand wraps with textured grip surfaces designed for grappling — improved purchase on fabric, skin, and armor without the rigidity of gloves. Common in training halls and tournaments. [ Basic | Common | Fight-Day Market, Korrvane ]

Reinforced fighting wraps.name: Reinforced fighting wraps
Reinforced fighting wraps.description: Combat-grade hand and wrist wraps with impact padding and reinforced knuckle coverage. Protect the hands during strikes while maintaining the grip flexibility grappling demands. [ Basic | Common | Fight-Day Market, Korrvane ]

Masterwork combat bindings.name: Masterwork combat bindings
Masterwork combat bindings.description: Exceptional hand, wrist, and forearm bindings constructed from layered advanced textiles. Combine striking protection, grappling grip, and joint support in a single integrated wrap system. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Fight-Day Market, Korrvane ]

Starian aerial lance.name: Starian aerial lance
Starian aerial lance.description: A lightweight lance designed for Starian aerial combat — weighted for stability in flight, with a grip that accommodates aerial angles and a shaft that survives impact at flight speed. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Korrvane ]

Elyri resonant blade.name: Elyri resonant blade
Elyri resonant blade.description: A blade forged from resonance-compatible alloys that respond to embodied field contact. The weapon’s cutting properties are real and physical; the resonance enhances the wielder’s field connection, not the edge. [ Standard | Uncommon | Vexorath Fabrication Yards ]

Affinity focus rod.name: Affinity focus rod
Affinity focus rod.description: A compact rod constructed from field-compatible materials used by Starian affinity practitioners as a focus point for controlled expression. The rod concentrates attention, not power. [ Standard | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Ceremonial blade.name: Ceremonial blade
Ceremonial blade.description: A presentation-quality sword carried for ceremony, diplomatic occasions, and formal house business. The metalwork and finish are exceptional; the combat utility is secondary to the statement. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Padded cap.name: Padded cap
Padded cap.description: A basic head covering with light impact padding. Minimal protection against incidental contact; not rated for combat. [ Basic | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Standard helmet.name: Standard helmet
Standard helmet.description: A fitted protective helmet meeting baseline security and industrial specifications. Adequate impact and penetration resistance for standard threat levels. [ Standard | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Frontier salvage helm.name: Frontier salvage helm
Frontier salvage helm.description: A repaired and refitted helmet assembled from salvaged military components in a Dustfall workshop. Open-face design preserves visibility at the cost of coverage. [ Frontier | Common | Refit Row salvage ]

House-forged helm.name: House-forged helm
House-forged helm.description: A protective helmet manufactured to house garrison specifications — impact-rated liner, reinforced shell, and a profile that identifies the wearer’s affiliation at a glance. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Yalven Settled Fit ]

Patrol helmet.name: Patrol helmet
Patrol helmet.description: A security-grade helmet with integrated communication mounts and a wide visor. Standard issue for civic patrol and perimeter security across Nexara. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Relstaris civic issue ]

Combat visor.name: Combat visor
Combat visor.description: A tactical half-helmet with an articulated visor and built-in threat indicators. Favoured by combat professionals who prioritise situational awareness over maximum head coverage. [ Standard | Uncommon | Vexorath Exchange ]

Starian flight visor.name: Starian flight visor
Starian flight visor.description: An aerodynamic half-helm designed for Starian aerial use — minimal drag, wind deflection, and eye protection at flight speed without restricting the peripheral vision flight demands. [ Standard | Uncommon | Korrvane ]

Kharai sensory helm.name: Kharai sensory helm
Kharai sensory helm.description: A protective helmet designed for Kharai biology — open-ear construction that preserves auditory discrimination, with scent channels that avoid filtering the information Kharai hearing and scenting depend on. [ Standard | Uncommon | Yalven Settled Fit ]

Light work tunic.name: Light work tunic
Light work tunic.description: A reinforced tunic with modest torso protection for general work and light security duties. Comfortable enough for a full shift; protective enough to matter in an incident. [ Basic | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Standard patrol vest.name: Standard patrol vest
Standard patrol vest.description: A torso protector meeting patrol security specifications — rated for common threat levels, fitted for movement, and compatible with standard harness attachments. [ Standard | Restricted | Relstaris civic issue ]

Dravon defense plate.name: Dravon defense plate
Dravon defense plate.description: Heavy body armor manufactured to Dravon garrison standards — maximum protection, minimal concession to mobility. Built for holding a position, not chasing targets. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Dravon garrison issue ]

Corsair mobile armor.name: Corsair mobile armor
Corsair mobile armor.description: Torso armor designed for the Corsair emphasis on movement — segmented construction, reduced weight, and articulation points that preserve the full range of motion combat footwork demands. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Corsair Cache, Korrvane ]

Masterwork body plate.name: Masterwork body plate
Masterwork body plate.description: Exceptional body armor produced to the highest available specification — layered construction, fitted articulation, and material quality that provides maximum protection without unnecessary weight. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

House-forged cuirass.name: House-forged cuirass
House-forged cuirass.description: A torso plate manufactured by a recognised house forge to inherited specifications. Heavy, reliable, and marked with the forge’s stamp. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Olyth adaptive vest.name: Olyth adaptive vest
