conditions.query: The player has just lost a sanctioned Korrvane bout — a qualifier or a main-bracket round — with the result decided by surrender, incapacitation, ring or airspace conditions, technical stoppage or judge ruling

effects.instruction: The bout is lost and ruled, and the player's run in this cycle is over. Nobody dies in the Arena: the medics take over at the Medic Gate, the Recovery Yards and the Injury Registry Desk record what was actually damaged and what rest is required, and the result stands. Korrvane respects a clean loss, effort and the willingness to come back; it remembers excuses. Whoever vouched for the player has their own reaction.

conditions.query: The player has been disqualified from Korrvane's bracket or removed by the judges or medics: undeclared equipment, endangering civilians, attacking outside the declared combat space, continuing after a medical stoppage, allies interfering, damaging Arena safety systems, coercive tactics, or refusing required treatment

effects.instruction: The judges' ruling stands and the player is removed from sanctioned competition until cleared. Registrars will refuse entries, sponsors withdraw, the Injury Registry holds the record, and a house may protest a stoppage but the fighter stays out until cleared. Deliberate lethal escalation would carry severe civic consequences beyond the Arena. Clearance comes from the judges and medics after the required rest, treatment and any protest, not from persuasion.

conditions.query: The judges and medics have formally cleared the player to compete again in Korrvane after a suspension, with the required rest, treatment and any protest resolved

effects.instruction: The suspension is lifted and the Injury Registry marks the player cleared. The record of why it happened does not vanish; registrars and bookmakers remember it, and the next registration is scrutinised.

conditions.query: The player's weekly final at the Tournament Grounds is about to begin or is being called
The player, as the certified weekly champion, has publicly accepted the Genesis Ladder before the judges
The player, as the certified weekly champion, has publicly accepted the Genesis Ladder before the judges
The player, as the certified weekly champion, has publicly declined the Genesis Ladder before the judges

effects.instruction: Declining the ladder is valid participation and Korrvane treats it that way: the champion keeps the result, the Victory Wall records the cycle, and the decision is read by the crowd and the houses according to how it was made. Some respect the honesty; some wanted the silence. The cycle closes with the champion's medical review and the after-match commons.

arena_beyond_first_gate.name: arena_beyond_first_gate

conditions.query: The player has defeated Alcandrus Genesis in a certified Genesis Ladder attempt, with the result ruled by the judges

arena_beyond_first_gate.script: const _r=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(!new RegExp('^(The\ Stacked\ City|The\ Arena\ Bowl|Genesis\ Cliffs|The\ Bronze\ Tiers|Zelvaris\ Fringe|Korrvane\ Approach|Tallwood\ Close|The\ Approach\ Deeps)$').test(_r)){skip=true;}

effects.instruction: This has never happened. The silence breaks into something the Arena has no rehearsed sound for. Tacitus and Corvinus Genesis confer in view of the crowd about whether any further stage is offered, to whom, and whether it would be ceremonial, technical or fully competitive; they weigh the champion's condition and the risk to everyone in the bowl. Alcandrus laughs, then does not. Every minor house re-reads the impossible standard tonight. Do not stage a numbered sequence of Genesis relatives.

Titles already won are kept as record; nothing is defended.'});}

arena_phase_qualifiers.name: arena_phase_qualifiers

conditions.query: The player is at the Arena, the Local Bracket Displays or the Bracket Supply Market, or is following or discussing this tenday's Korrvane bracket

arena_phase_qualifiers.script: const _r=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(!new RegExp('^(The\ Stacked\ City|The\ Arena\ Bowl|Genesis\ Cliffs|The\ Bronze\ Tiers|Zelvaris\ Fringe|Korrvane\ Approach|Tallwood\ Close|The\ Approach\ Deeps)$').test(_r)){skip=true;}

effects.instruction: Days one to six of the tenday: qualifier phase. Rotating district qualifiers for the smaller recognised houses and open-entry qualifiers for approved outsiders run at the Tournament Grounds and the Aerial Ring under judges, feeding the open slots of the thirty-two; Orvantis, Zelvaris, Caelthorn, Aevon, Luxaryn and Vorreth hold one guaranteed slot each while they keep district standing, one active representative per house, rotated at the house's discretion. Registration, medical checks at the Medic Gate and equipment inspection happen now; the Local Bracket Displays show who is in, prior results and public odds; the Bracket Supply Market is stocking. Seeding follows recent performance without fully determining it. This is ordinary city rhythm, not a summons.

arena_phase_main_rounds.name: arena_phase_main_rounds

conditions.query: The player is at the Arena, the Local Bracket Displays or the Bracket Supply Market, or is following or discussing this tenday's Korrvane bracket

arena_phase_main_rounds.script: const _r=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(!new RegExp('^(The\ Stacked\ City|The\ Arena\ Bowl|Genesis\ Cliffs|The\ Bronze\ Tiers|Zelvaris\ Fringe|Korrvane\ Approach|Tallwood\ Close|The\ Approach\ Deeps)$').test(_r)){skip=true;}

effects.instruction: Main bracket days. The seventh day runs the round of thirty-two and the round of sixteen, district-heavy and loud; the eighth runs the quarterfinals and semifinals with the wider city arriving, the House Seating Tiers filling by house colour, the Betting Stands busy and the Public Commentary Perches live. Contenders fight one per house; Caelthorn argues seeding language, Vorreth results break the odds, Aevon wins in the Aerial Ring. Matches end by surrender, incapacitation, ring or airspace conditions, technical stoppage or judge ruling; medics can stop anything. The Recovery Yards fill. Nobody dies.

arena_phase_rest_day.name: arena_phase_rest_day

conditions.query: The player is at the Arena, the Recovery Yards or the Victory Wall, or is following the aftermath of the weekly final

arena_phase_rest_day.script: const _r=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(!new RegExp('^(The\ Stacked\ City|The\ Arena\ Bowl|Genesis\ Cliffs|The\ Bronze\ Tiers|Zelvaris\ Fringe|Korrvane\ Approach|Tallwood\ Close|The\ Approach\ Deeps)$').test(_r)){skip=true;}

effects.instruction: Tenth day, rest: the Arena is quiet. The Victory Wall has last night's result; the Recovery Yards and the Injury Registry Desk are the busiest places in the district; the Zelvaris Recovery Annex runs its methods; bookmakers settle; the houses hold their own reckonings in their quarters. Registration for the next cycle opens tomorrow. Nothing official happens today.

arena_highfire_season.name: arena_highfire_season

conditions.query: The player is in Korrvane near the Arena, the bracket displays or the gate plazas, or is following the tournament season

arena_highfire_season.script: const _r=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(!new RegExp('^(The\ Stacked\ City|The\ Arena\ Bowl|Genesis\ Cliffs|The\ Bronze\ Tiers|Zelvaris\ Fringe|Korrvane\ Approach|Tallwood\ Close|The\ Approach\ Deeps)$').test(_r)){skip=true;}

effects.instruction: Highfire: tournament season in Korrvane. The weekly cycle runs as always, but the open-entry qualifiers swell with visiting fighters from other cities and offworld, the Gate Plazas and arrival platforms are crowded on bracket days, the minor houses field their strongest representatives every cycle rather than rotating, sponsorship offers and outsider entries are at their yearly peak, and the season builds toward the Grand Bracket in Highfire's last tenday. Lodging near the bowl is scarce; the Bracket Supply Market never fully closes.
This cycle's champion is the Grand Bracket champion: the Victory Wall records the year, every visiting delegation saw it, and the name will be known outside Korrvane by the next season.

aerial_contest_won.name: aerial_contest_won

conditions.query: The player has won a declared aerial contest in Korrvane — an Aerial Ring bout, a race or a movement challenge inside a marked Challenge Lane — judged by an official with the result ruled

aerial_contest_won.script: const _r=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(!new RegExp('^(The\ Stacked\ City|The\ Arena\ Bowl|Genesis\ Cliffs|The\ Bronze\ Tiers|Zelvaris\ Fringe|Korrvane\ Approach|Tallwood\ Close|The\ Approach\ Deeps)$').test(_r)){skip=true;}

effects.instruction: A declared aerial result, judged and ruled. House Aevon's fliers notice; the flight-lane instructors know the name; the Local Bracket Displays may carry it as a side result. A race in a Transit Lane or a fight in gate approach airspace would have been hostile conduct, not a contest.

conditions.query: The player, a registered student, has won an approved student challenge in the Public Challenge Ring and has been entered in the campus rankings

effects.instruction: An approved challenge, won and entered in the rankings. Instructors treat it as information about what to teach next; Aurex Genesis notices technique, not glory. Rankings are internal to the campus; sponsors may not publicly claim participants, and any betting around student matches is illegal and draws the Combat Ethics Chamber. This is not Korrvane.

conditions.query: The player has passed a formal grading in the Wayline sword tradition before Rux Corsair's instructors at the Blade Courts

effects.instruction: A grading passed at the Blade Courts, with families and visiting duellists watching. It recognises technique and conduct within the school; it is not a rank in House Corsair, not a licence to teach and not a tournament result. Vaelor Corsair marks it in the Wayline Archive; Seryn Corsair has an opinion; across the river, House Veltrax notes another Corsair-trained name.

conditions.query: The player has won a formal, declared public challenge on the Public Challenge Floor of the Veltrax Redcourt District under House Veltrax's conditions

effects.instruction: A formal Redcourt challenge, won under Veltrax conditions with the Instructor Gallery watching; the Trophy Wall notes it. Arvessa Veltrax's school is proud and competitive, never lawless; the win earns respect here and attention from Rux Corsair's students, especially if it was won in a Corsair style. It confers nothing in Korrvane.

conditions.query: The player has won the headline match of the Hollow Ring and the crowd or the Ruin Board is calling them the Hollow Champion

effects.instruction: The Ring's crowd has a new name for the player and no institution recognises it. Varek Zelvaris settles the books; the Recruitment Balcony makes offers; the Match-Fixing Office has a use for a champion; Syla Volen watches how they won. Outside: Kira Dorr's investigations, Valerius Genesis deciding whether enforcement protects or scatters the fighters, and any sanctioned registration desk that checks records. Money, secrecy and debt are the Ring's currencies. Nothing here reaches the Victory Wall.

effects.instruction: The player stands on the ladder as Grade 3, a Gray: the broad standard mass of the city. Nobody announces it; it is how the queues move for them, which ring gates open, how often the audit comes, which Provision Hall shelf they may use. The people's names for the grades are used on the rows and officially ignored. Do not state a number to the player unless a clerk, a record or an audit says it in the scene.

The grade decides housing ring, work assignment, movement radius, queue speed, audit frequency and a child's starting grade; audits weigh family association, so a relative's standing moves with it. Nivarek's Standing Offices decided this; the Kathvar clerk only handed it over.

quilrath_audit_summons.name: quilrath_audit_summons
quilrath_audit_summons.script: const _rg=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(["The Black Star Rise", "Gateward Compound", "Bastion Hard", "The Outer Blockworks", "The Bridged Blocks", "The Gray Rings", "Terrace Row", "Dustward Edge", "The Curfew Corridors", "The Glass Rise", "The Glass Threshold", "The Numbered Streets", "The Scrub Margin", "The Ashring Stacks", "The Darkened Rows", "The Outer Yards", "The Patrol Runs", "The Camp Line", "The Faded Blocks", "Southreach Edge", "The Boundary Line"].indexOf(_rg)<0){skip=true;}else{const m=check({type:'read-number',key:'quilrath.marks'})||0;if(storage.summonsAt===m){skip=true;}else{storage.summonsAt=m;effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'The record has accumulated enough entries — late arrivals at closed gates, movement outside the permitted radius, a logged argument with an operator — that a Standing review is now scheduled. A summons reaches the player through the work-order boards or a Kathvar clerk: a date, a Standing Office, a list of the entries to be weighed, and a note that family association will be considered. Nothing is decided yet; the audit decides. Let the people around them react to the word audit.'});}}

quilrath_audit_lowered.name: quilrath_audit_lowered

conditions.query: A Standing Office audit or review of the player has concluded by lowering the player's Civic Standing Grade

quilrath_audit_lowered.script: const g=check({type:'read-number',key:'quilrath.grade'})||0;const n=Math.min(5,g+1);effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.grade',operator:'set',value:n});effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.marks',operator:'set',value:0});effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.audits',operator:'add',value:1});const names=['', 'Grade 1, the Polished', 'Grade 2, Gatefolk', 'Grade 3, Grays', 'Grade 4, Half-lights', 'Grade 5, Ashfeet'];effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'The audit has lowered the player to '+names[n]+'. Play the consequence as procedure, not theatre: a housing reassignment notice, a narrower movement radius printed at the Permit Desk, slower queues, more frequent audits, and relatives pulled into review because association weighs. If the new grade is 4, curfew now applies to them; if 5, movement is by work order only. The decision was Nivarek\'s; the Kathvar clerk who hands it over did not make it and cannot unmake it.'});

quilrath_audit_raised.name: quilrath_audit_raised

conditions.query: A Standing Office audit or review of the player, or recognised civic or military service, has concluded by raising the player's Civic Standing Grade

quilrath_audit_raised.script: const g=check({type:'read-number',key:'quilrath.grade'})||0;const n=Math.max(1,g-1);effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.grade',operator:'set',value:n});effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.marks',operator:'set',value:0});effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.audits',operator:'add',value:1});const names=['', 'Grade 1, the Polished', 'Grade 2, Gatefolk', 'Grade 3, Grays', 'Grade 4, Half-lights', 'Grade 5, Ashfeet'];effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'The record now carries the player as '+names[n]+'. The change arrives as paperwork: a housing ring that may open, a wider radius, faster queues, a longer interval before the next audit, and a family whose own standing rises with it. If the new grade is 3 or better, curfew no longer binds them, though the ring gates still log every crossing. Neighbours notice a climb; some are glad, some remember.'});

conditions.query: A Standing Office audit or review of the player has concluded with the player's Civic Standing Grade confirmed unchanged

effects.instruction: The audit closes with the grade confirmed. The entries that brought it on are not erased; they are weighed and filed, and the next review will read them again. Relief on the rows is quiet and brief.

quilrath_curfew_recorded.name: quilrath_curfew_recorded

conditions.query: The player, a curfewed resident of Quilrath, has been found on the rows or at a closed curfew gate after closing without a permit covering the hours, and an operator, a reader post or a drone has logged it

quilrath_curfew_recorded.script: const _rg=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(["The Outer Blockworks", "The Bridged Blocks", "The Gray Rings", "Terrace Row", "Dustward Edge", "The Curfew Corridors", "The Glass Rise", "The Glass Threshold", "The Numbered Streets", "The Scrub Margin", "The Ashring Stacks", "The Darkened Rows", "The Outer Yards", "The Patrol Runs", "The Camp Line", "The Faded Blocks", "Southreach Edge", "The Boundary Line"].indexOf(_rg)<0){skip=true;}

effects.instruction: The record notes it. No fine, no cell, no speech: the operator's reader logs the identity, the time and whether the player argued, and the entry joins the file the next audit will read. If the player has family on the rows, the entry touches them too. Let the scene carry the weight of a small thing that is not small.

quilrath_permit_issued.name: quilrath_permit_issued

conditions.query: A Kathvar clerk at a Permit Desk has issued the player a movement, work or visit permit whose hours extend past curfew, printed as a distance and a set of hours

quilrath_permit_issued.script: const _rg=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(["The Black Star Rise", "Gateward Compound", "Bastion Hard", "The Outer Blockworks", "The Bridged Blocks", "The Gray Rings", "Terrace Row", "Dustward Edge", "The Curfew Corridors", "The Glass Rise", "The Glass Threshold", "The Numbered Streets", "The Scrub Margin", "The Ashring Stacks", "The Darkened Rows", "The Outer Yards", "The Patrol Runs", "The Camp Line", "The Faded Blocks", "Southreach Edge", "The Boundary Line"].indexOf(_rg)<0){skip=true;}else{const d=check({type:'read-number',key:'calendar.day'})||0;effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.night_permit',operator:'set',value:1});effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.permit_day',operator:'set',value:d});effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'The permit is real and narrow: a distance and a set of hours, checked against the record, granted for this tenday. The clerk followed rules written elsewhere and did not decide anything about the player\'s standing.'});}

quilrath_permit_lapse.name: quilrath_permit_lapse
quilrath_permit_lapse.script: const d=check({type:'read-number',key:'calendar.day'})||0;const p=check({type:'read-number',key:'quilrath.permit_day'})||0;if(d<=p+10){skip=true;}else{effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'quilrath.night_permit',operator:'set',value:0});effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'The player\'s movement permit has run out its set of hours and its tenday. conditions.query: The player's Quilrath movement permit has been narrowed to exclude curfew hours, refused on renewal, or revoked

effects.instruction: The permit no longer covers the hours. It happens on paper, at a counter, from a clerk who did not decide it; the reason, if one is given, is the record. The gates close on the player like everyone else on their rung now.

quilrath_ring_gate_day.name: quilrath_ring_gate_day

conditions.query: By day, the player is passing a ring gate, a checkpoint chain, the Civic Counters or the Inner Compliance Gate in Quilrath, or is being processed at one

quilrath_ring_gate_day.script: const _rg=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(["The Black Star Rise", "Gateward Compound", "Bastion Hard", "The Outer Blockworks", "The Bridged Blocks", "The Gray Rings", "Terrace Row", "Dustward Edge", "The Curfew Corridors", "The Glass Rise", "The Glass Threshold", "The Numbered Streets", "The Scrub Margin", "The Ashring Stacks", "The Darkened Rows", "The Outer Yards", "The Patrol Runs", "The Camp Line", "The Faded Blocks", "Southreach Edge", "The Boundary Line"].indexOf(_rg)<0){skip=true;}else{const g=check({type:'read-number',key:'quilrath.grade'})||0;let t;if(g===0){t='The player is processed as an outsider under the Access Level system: identity, purpose, sponsor and escort are logged, scanned, ranked and assigned movement permissions at the Inner Compliance Gate under Tarsen Dravon\'s command; a Processed Visitor moves on approved routes, an Escorted Inner Visitor only with a Dravon, Nivarek or Balrath escort, and an unmarked person is detained or turned back. Being important is not being cleared.';}else if(g<=2){t='The gate reads the player\'s standing and lets them through with a scan and a nod: Grade '+g+' passes most ring gates. The queue for them is short; the queue beside them is not.';}else if(g===3){t='Standard processing: the scan, the queue, the operator\'s glance at the record, the wait. Grays cross ring gates on standing alone within their movement radius; beyond it, the Permit Desk. Surveillance is total here and threadbare in the deep rows behind them.';}else if(g===4){t='The reader flags the grade. Questions, a radius check, a note; a Half-light crossing a ring gate is a small event in the file every time, and an argument is a bigger one. Kathvar operators follow rules written elsewhere; Dalan Kathvar\'s whole authority is to refer a case upward.';}else{t='Without a work order the gate does not open for Ashfeet. The Labor Transit Intake and the Work-Order Muster are the only routes that exist, and a Tracker follows anyone who tries another.';}effects.push({type:'story',instruction:t});}

Tools of the dead are displayed, then returned to service — nothing is wasted in Dustfall. It is not a celebration. It is an acknowledgment. The Last Line Company stands formal guard. effects.instruction: The Survival Games at Dustfall. effects.instruction: The Grand Bracket: Highfire's last tenday, the culmination of tournament season. Same thirty-two-slot format, same judges, same rules, but the open-entry qualifiers are the fiercest of the year and drawn from across Nexara, the House Seating Tiers are full every day, the City Watch Perches are doubled, the Betting Stands raise their lines and the Bracket Supply Market runs day and night. Tournament administration under Tacitus Genesis runs it; House Genesis watches from above. The Grand Bracket champion is recorded on the Victory Wall with the year and faces the same public ladder question as any weekly champion. Side events on the Civic Training Platforms and the Challenge Lanes fill every free space.

effects.instruction: An invitation to the unsanctioned night circuit: reinforced chambers off the Lower Grounds that appear on no city map, conditions set by whoever holds the purse rather than the judges, no medic gate, and a crowd of house representatives who should not be there, information brokers and people without public names. Attendance needs standing; participating needs more. Nothing that happens here is a sanctioned result, everything that happens here is remembered by someone, and a fighter caught between this circuit and the Weekly Bracket will be asked about it at the Registration Hall.

effects.instruction: The Open Circle's open assembly on Circle Isle: Nexara's home of learned magic opens its Lecture Rings to anyone willing to come across the bridges or the ferry. Certifications are conferred, students demonstrate workings paid for in their own Vitality, cargo-seal and route-charm piecework is shown beside serious inscription, the Corsair Magic Branch attends, and the Academy's people come to compare. It is a school's public day, not a diplomatic body: the Circle mediates nothing and rules nothing, and most Helvyrans watch with curiosity rather than reverence.

Formations march through the Black Star Rise, administrative achievements are publicly recognized, and the city's order is displayed for all to see. It is part celebration, part reminder. effects.instruction: Archive Gala at Solvraxis. A rare formal celebration — the Academy opens previously restricted collections for a single evening of curated display, scholarly recognition, and institutional self-congratulation. The archivists, normally the quietest people in the city, become the evening's hosts. Rare texts are displayed under protective glass. Senior researchers receive honors. And beneath the ceremony, careful observers notice which collections were chosen for display — and which remain locked.

conditions.query: The player notices a large-scale academic gathering in Solvraxis — researchers presenting findings, cross-discipline conferences, visiting scholars from other cities, or formal symposium activities

effects.instruction: The Grand Symposium at Solvraxis. Researchers from across the Academy network gather to present findings, debate theories, and establish the next cycle's research priorities. Visiting scholars from Relstaris bring Republic funding perspectives. The event draws attention from every faction with an interest in knowledge — which is all of them. Public lectures run alongside closed sessions, and the hallway conversations between presentations are where the real intellectual alliances form.

conditions.query: The player notices a formal recognition ceremony at Vexorath — distinguished technical, civic or defense service being acknowledged before the city

effects.instruction: A recognition ceremony at Vexorath. House Contair and the Resident Assembly acknowledge service above the expected standard: engineers, custodians, medical staff of the Myralis Continuum, drone crews and civilians whose work held during an emergency. It is precise and solemn, with the names entered in the city's permanent record and the Luminas present as the city's own. Contair confers no military rank in the Genesis or Dravon sense; authority here follows the problem, and the ceremony honours competence, review and responsibility. Attendance at the public portions is a privilege, and a civilian who witnesses it sees Vexorath at its most sincere.

conditions.query: The player notices large-scale defense exercises at Vexorath — coordinated drone drills, simulated breach responses and logistics stress tests across the systems-city

effects.instruction: Defense exercises at Vexorath. House Contair runs the systems-city through a full drill: Ward and Aegis formations deploying from Armada Holds, simulated breach responses on the Outer Shell, lift and supply stress tests, emergency priority passing to the most relevant qualified person and back again, and every decision logged for review afterward, because Vexorath reviews everything. Drones outnumber people in the streets. For Contair it is maintenance of a city built from centuries of Dravon assaults; for visitors it is a demonstration of exactly how prepared the city is. Observation is permitted from designated platforms for those with clearance, and Rezulith Contair's technical authority, not any other House, governs the exercise.

conditions.query: The player is in Korrvane on the day of the weekly final — crowd energy, bracket announcements, fighters preparing, or the final being discussed

effects.instruction: Ninth day, market day: the weekly final, a citywide event. Work stops early; the Arena Street Food Ring and Luxaryn's vendors are at full strength, the Gate Plazas take the overflow, the Betting Stands close their lines before the bout, and the residential levels throb. The final is fought before the judges under declared conditions; afterwards the champion appears before the judges, takes medical review, stands for the record and answers publicly whether they accept or decline the Genesis Ladder. If they accept, the bowl goes silent for the attempt against Alcandrus Genesis. The after-match commons at Luxaryn run late. Any player not competing experiences this as the city's rhythm, not as an obligation.

conditions.query: It is nighttime in Korrvane and the player is near the arena, the lower grounds or the after-match commons

effects.instruction: Below the official brackets, unsanctioned night fights run in converted storage bays and cleared loading docks on the Lower Grounds: no judges, no guaranteed medics, looser conditions, real money changing hands, and people whose names appear in no record. Korrvane permits structured conflict, not uncontrolled harm; the City Watch Perches intervene when civilians are endangered or a fight spills into lanes, and a result here earns nothing on the Victory Wall and can cost a sanctioned entry if it surfaces at registration.

rhythm_quilrath_audit_cycle_r1.name: rhythm_quilrath_audit_cycle_r1

conditions.query: The player notices increased bureaucratic activity, identity checks, or official inspections in Quilrath

effects.instruction: Audit cycle in Quilrath. House Dravon's administrative apparatus runs a systematic review — identity papers checked at every transit point, work logs audited, residential permits verified. The city moves slower, the queues longer, and the officials more deliberate. Residents know the drill. Outsiders learn quickly.

rhythm_quilrath_audit_cycle_r1.script: const _rg=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(["The Black Star Rise", "Gateward Compound", "Bastion Hard", "The Outer Blockworks", "The Bridged Blocks", "The Gray Rings", "Terrace Row", "Dustward Edge", "The Curfew Corridors", "The Glass Rise", "The Glass Threshold", "The Numbered Streets", "The Scrub Margin", "The Ashring Stacks", "The Darkened Rows", "The Outer Yards", "The Patrol Runs", "The Camp Line", "The Faded Blocks", "Southreach Edge", "The Boundary Line"].indexOf(_rg)<0){skip=true;}

rhythm_quilrath_curfew_r1.name: rhythm_quilrath_curfew_r1

conditions.query: It is night in Quilrath and the player is out on the rows, at a ring gate or curfew gate, in a plaza, or moving between rings

rhythm_quilrath_curfew_r1.script: const _rg=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(["The Black Star Rise", "Gateward Compound", "Bastion Hard", "The Outer Blockworks", "The Bridged Blocks", "The Gray Rings", "Terrace Row", "Dustward Edge", "The Curfew Corridors", "The Glass Rise", "The Glass Threshold", "The Numbered Streets", "The Scrub Margin", "The Ashring Stacks", "The Darkened Rows", "The Outer Yards", "The Patrol Runs", "The Camp Line", "The Faded Blocks", "Southreach Edge", "The Boundary Line"].indexOf(_rg)<0){skip=true;}else{const g=check({type:'read-number',key:'quilrath.grade'})||0;const p=check({type:'read-number',key:'quilrath.night_permit'})||0;const inner=["The Black Star Rise", "Gateward Compound", "Bastion Hard"].indexOf(_rg)>=0;let t;if(inner){t='Night in the Inner Circle runs on Access Levels, not curfew: the Rank Gates divide movement by clearance, escort and rank mark; the Civic Watch Plazas keep their pylons, rank scanners and silent Sentry patrols; a low-clearance or unmarked person is halted, scanned and held, and a Tracker follows whoever leaves a plaza without clearance. High clearance means quiet corrections; low clearance means public ones. Nobody is exempt by being important; they are exempt by being cleared.';}else if(g===0){t='The player is not on the ladder: a processed or escorted visitor, or unmarked. Night in the outer rings is not their curfew, but it is not their city either: off an approved route or without an escort the pylons at the ring gates read them, a Sentry marks them and a Tracker follows, and an unmarked person is detained, questioned, redirected or transferred to Nivarek review. Locals will not be seen helping them.';}else if(g<=2){t='The player is Grade '+g+'; curfew does not bind them, but the ring gates log every crossing after closing and the record is what the next audit reads. Operators are polite to the Polished and brisk with Gatefolk. Streets past the gates are quiet; the people out are shift workers with orders, and the drones watch the gates, not the rows.';}else if(g===3){t='The player is a Gray: not curfewed, but a late return through a ring gate is scanned, logged and remembered, and Grays learn to be inside before the rows go quiet. The deep rows past the pylons are where the city talks; the gates are where it listens.';}else if(g===4&&p>0){t='The player is Grade 4 and curfewed, but holds a Permit Desk movement permit whose hours cover this: the reader post accepts it, the operator notes it, the light stays what it is. Every use is logged; a permit is a leash with a known length, and it can be narrowed next month.';}else if(g===4){t='The player is Grade 4, Half-light: curfewed and audited. The curfew gates across the rows are closed, scanned and logged, staffed by bored operators with total authority over a few minutes. The curfew covers the air too: flying over the rows or between rings is being out, and Dravon aerial patrols launch to catch fliers. Without a permit covering the hours, being out is an entry in the record; a late arrival argues or does not, and the record notes it either way. No hour is announced; the rows know their closing. Do not invent a fine or a cell: the consequence is the record, the audit and the grade.';}else{t='The player is Grade 5, Ashfeet: movement by work order only, night or day. Outside a work order the Camp Perimeter and the Labor Transit Intake are the only doors that exist, and a person on the rows without one is an entry, a Tracker, and a review. Care runs on ration allotments and the stubbornness of physicians like Varda Olm.';}effects.push({type:'story',instruction:t});}

rhythm_relstaris_academy_exams_r1.name: rhythm_relstaris_academy_exams_r1

conditions.query: The player notices heightened academic activity near the Academy — students studying, examination halls being prepared, or results being posted

effects.instruction: Ashfall — evaluation season across the Republic's schools. The atmosphere hardens: study groups claim every space, libraries run extended hours, examination halls are locked until the appointed time and the Closed Examination Floor is shielded from spectators and bookmakers. Practical evaluations run on the courts and benches — affinity control, flight, movement, craft — and apprentices are assessed at their bays. Faculty move with the weary patience of a thousand cycles. A character being evaluated is judged on the actual work of the year; results post in the last tenday.

conditions.query: The player notices a new archive section opening, rare texts being displayed, or special academic events at Solvraxis

effects.instruction: A restricted archive section has opened for limited access. Researchers queue with their credentials, debating which texts to prioritize in the narrow window. The archivists preside with the quiet authority of people who control access to irreplaceable knowledge. Every opening is an event — some of these texts haven't been read in decades.

rhythm_solvraxis_field_expedition_r1.name: rhythm_solvraxis_field_expedition_r1

conditions.query: The player notices researchers preparing for an expedition, field equipment being organized, or academic teams departing Solvraxis

effects.instruction: A research expedition is departing Solvraxis. The field team loads equipment onto transport — survey instruments, specimen containers, and enough provisions for a week in the wilds. The academic community watches with a mix of excitement and concern. Field work beyond the settled regions is where new knowledge lives, but it's also where researchers sometimes don't come back.

rhythm_vexorath_security_drill_r1.name: rhythm_vexorath_security_drill_r1

conditions.query: The player notices increased military activity, security lockdowns, or drill exercises at Vexorath

effects.instruction: Security drill at the citadel. The entire fortress-city shifts to heightened protocol — additional checkpoints activate, the upper levels restrict access, and armored units run formation exercises through the gate corridors. It's routine, the guards say. But routine at Vexorath means the kind of preparedness most cities only dream about.

rhythm_vexorath_security_drill_r1.script: const _rg=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(!new RegExp('^(The\ Eastward\ Face|The\ Gate\ Approach|The\ Residential\ Tier|Civic\ Systems\ Level|The\ Outer\ Shell|Armada\ Shelf|The\ Pinnacle|Vexorath\ High\ Air|Cold\ Summit\ Sky|Snow\ Saddle|The\ Grey\ Cleft|Outerridge\ Air|Cloud\-Bank\ Air)$').test(_rg)){skip=true;}

rhythm_vexorath_supply_lift_r1.name: rhythm_vexorath_supply_lift_r1

conditions.query: The player notices large-scale supply movement, cargo lifts operating at capacity, or logistics activity at Vexorath

effects.instruction: Supply lift day. The great cargo elevators run at full capacity, hauling provisions and materiel from the Gate Approach to the upper citadel levels. The organized chaos of military logistics plays out on every platform — manifests checked, crates sorted, damaged goods flagged for return. The citadel feeds itself in cycles, and this is the day.

conditions.query: Hadrik Vaelith or Iria Vaereth has told the player in person about people living inside the sealed wing of the Vaelith compound and asked for help settling where they will live.

effects.instruction: At Declining Compound Row in Hundred Houses Quarter, Hadrik Vaelith can offer this work during a direct conversation: Settle where the households found in the sealed wing will live, on terms Hadrik Vaelith and Iria Vaereth both accept and say to each other. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Hadrik and Iria remember exactly what was said in the sealed wing and hold each other to it. The households placed there or moved stay where the settlement put them. Elyss Auren and Daelor Ravello know the outcome; the ownership question Daelor raised remains open and nobody in the Hundred Houses Quarter treats it as closed.

conditions.query: Branna Sol or Calia Varriko has asked the player in person to help bring the service contracts and their signers before the Fair Contract Review Office.

effects.instruction: At Open Contract Hall, Branna Sol can offer this work during a direct conversation: Carry the contract review through to Calia Varriko's recorded ruling with the signers' actual testimony on the record. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Calia Varriko's ruling stands in the Closed Contract Archive and is cited by Branna Sol and by employers who lost. The signers remember who spoke for them. Tavik Corsair remembers whether the player's work helped or cost the cargo crews. Whether the workers strike remains their own decision, unsettled by this ruling.

conditions.query: Kessa Ruun has proposed the run to the player in person at the Hidden Cargo Exchange and named Talik Nox's route through the Deepways.

effects.instruction: At Hidden Cargo Exchange in The Vein Market, Kessa Ruun can offer this work during a direct conversation: Get the passenger through the Deepways to the agreed handoff or refuse the run, and settle with Kessa Ruun and Talik Nox what the route actually cost. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Kessa Ruun and Talik Nox remember how the player behaved when the passenger turned. Any route that was seen is burned for them and stays burned. Kira Dorr remembers a face if she saw one. Injuries and lost gear persist; nobody in Low Relstaris speaks of it as a rescue or a crime until someone chooses to.

conditions.query: Viaro Bellovari has asked the player in person to carry his reunion invitation to Arissa Bellovari in Relstaris and to sit as the neutral guest.

effects.instruction: At Starfall Market in Bellovari Market District, Viaro Bellovari can offer this work during a direct conversation: Carry Viaro Bellovari's invitation to Arissa Bellovari in person and bring the reunion to an actual sitting, or an actual refusal, at the Silver Cup Pub. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The Bellovaris of both cities remember who carried the invitation and what was said at the Silver Cup. Liora repeats none of it and decides a great deal by what she chooses not to repeat. The question of who left whom is exactly as alive as it was, only now with one more evening attached to it.

conditions.query: Renzo Orvessa has asked the player in person to work the emergency reserve reconciliation with Jovian Orvessa before the count is certified.

effects.instruction: At Public Clinic Recovery Room in Orvessa Welfare District, Renzo Orvessa can offer this work during a direct conversation: Complete the reconciliation of the emergency reserves and have Renzo Orvessa enter the certified count, or the recorded shortfall, in the welfare ledger. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Renzo Orvessa's ledger carries the count as entered and he argues from it with everyone equally. Jovian remembers whether the player counted with him or around him. Amara knows the district's real reserve, and the welfare district treats the player as someone who has seen its shelves.

conditions.questId: Solvraxis — Counting on No One Armed

conditions.query: Neressa Valcoro, Calessa Orvessa or Lucera Castro has told the player in person about the arrival shadowing Selene Castro and asked for help ending it without weapons.

effects.instruction: At Civic Peace Stations in Solvraxis, Neressa Valcoro can offer this work during a direct conversation: Identify what the visitor shadowing Selene Castro intends and end it without a weapon, through the Civic Peace Stations, the gate, or Caivan Castro's public defense. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

effects.value: Solvraxis — Counting on No One Armed

conditions.value: Solvraxis — Counting on No One Armed

effects.instruction: Neressa Valcoro and the Civic Peace Stations remember that the player kept the peace unarmed. Lucera and Caivan Castro remember who stood near Selene. Whoever sent the visitor is not established and the family does not pretend otherwise. Any injury from the confrontation heals at its own pace.

conditions.query: Nira Drathen or Kael Drathen has asked the player in person for help finishing a commission that Kael's hands can no longer complete.

effects.instruction: At The Lower Grounds, Nira Drathen can offer this work during a direct conversation: Finish the due commission with Nira Drathen and settle between Kael and Nira whose mark it leaves the shop under. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Kael and Nira Drathen remember what was said over the finished piece and whose mark went on it. The client knows what they received. Kael's hands are what they are; Nira's standing in the Bracket Supply Market follows what the city actually saw her deliver, not a title.

conditions.query: Bostarix Orvantis has told the player in person of the mismatch between Hasdrovex's injury record and his public bout and asked for help carrying the protest through the review.

effects.instruction: At The Recovery Yards, Bostarix Orvantis can offer this work during a direct conversation: See the Injury Registry review of Hasdrovex Orvantis's injuries through to a recorded finding and a ruling on Bostarix Orvantis's protest at the Judges' Dais. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The Injury Registry Desk keeps the finding and the Dais keeps its ruling; both are cited the next time a damage pattern looks wrong. Orvantis remembers who stood with Bostarix. Caelthorn remembers whether the player made an argument they could not answer. Hasdrovex heals at his own pace and the bracket record stands as ruled.

conditions.query: A Flight Lanes corridor has actually failed in play with people still in the air, and Yadira Aevon or Gisqon Aevon has enlisted the player to help clear it.

effects.instruction: At The Flight Lanes, Yadira Aevon can offer this work during a direct conversation: Help clear the failed corridor of everyone still in it and establish what actually happened before the lane is reopened, rerouted or closed. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Yadira and Gisqon Aevon remember who came down into the lane with them. The City Watch Perches hold the record of the corridor's status and of what was and was not established. Tacitus Genesis knows what Zephyra reported. Anyone hurt in the failure carries it; the cause stays exactly as uncertain as the record says.

conditions.query: Juna Dray has told the player in person that her solo skyhook certification is set and that Imma Dray refuses to watch, and has asked the player to stand with her.

effects.instruction: At Main Berth Line in The Barge Quays, Juna Dray can offer this work during a direct conversation: Stand with Juna Dray through her solo skyhook certification and bring Imma Dray to say, to Juna's face, whether she will watch. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The Certification Office holds Petch Immar's record of Juna's attempt as it actually went. Juna and Imma Dray remember what was said at the moorings and the river remembers who was watching. The Dray barge and its inheritance are exactly as unsettled as before, with one more thing the family knows about itself.

conditions.query: Dren Varriko has shown the player in person the three signed records for the same shipment at the Ledger Court Annex and asked for help tracing them.

effects.instruction: At Ledger Court Annex in The Grand Waypoint, Dren Varriko can offer this work during a direct conversation: Trace the three signed records to what actually moved and get the audit finding recorded at the Varriko Ledger Hall. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The Varriko Ledger Hall holds the finding and Dren Varriko cites it with his usual lack of expression. Sereth remembers whether the player's work supported or spoiled her fraud theory. Tavren Corsair remembers who took his manifest reading seriously. The wider forger question is no nearer an answer than before.

conditions.query: Sava Veltrax has proposed the escort contract to the player in person at the House Veltrax Office, and Korriven Corsair's place on the same convoy is known.

effects.instruction: At House Veltrax Office in Veltrax Redcourt District, Sava Veltrax can offer this work during a direct conversation: Ride the escort to its handoff and settle, with both houses' escorts present, what the route actually cost and who answered for it. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Sava Veltrax and Korriven Corsair each remember what the other's escort actually did on the road and tell it their own way; neither school's standing has changed. Injuries and armor damage persist and Fenra Yalven reads them if asked. The agreed fee is settled as agreed, no more. The cargo is where the handoff or the interruption left it.

conditions.query: Seris Contair, Lumina Minor or Paul Thovex has told the player in person about the workshop change made outside Rezulith's preferred architecture and asked for help bringing it to review.

effects.instruction: At Seris's Residence in Residential District, Seris Contair can offer this work during a direct conversation: Document what Lumina Minor changed and bring Seris and Rezulith Contair to an actual review of it, face to face, with the change kept, reverted or bounded. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Rezulith and Seris Contair remember what each conceded and what each refused on the fabrication floor, and the system stands as the review left it. Lumina Minor remembers who explained her work accurately. Paul Thovex keeps the peace he kept. The household argument about method is not over; it has one settled instance.

conditions.query: Paul Thovex has told the player in person that infrastructure monitoring recorded more of his household than intended and asked for help carrying the challenge through civic review.

effects.instruction: At Civic Systems Quarter, Paul Thovex can offer this work during a direct conversation: Carry Paul Thovex's monitoring challenge through the Privacy Challenge Chamber to a recorded decision. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The Privacy Challenge Chamber holds the decision and residents cite it the next time a connected system reveals more than it should. Maelis Contair remembers how the player handled a confused resident's evidence. Paul Thovex remembers who took his household seriously. Lumina Major said what she chose to and no more, and that stands.

conditions.query: An old Outer Shell layer has actually activated in play with residents caught inside it, and Tavris Contair or Torren Myralis has enlisted the player.

effects.instruction: At Outer Shell, Tavris Contair can offer this work during a direct conversation: Get the people caught in the active layer to the shelters and help bring the layer to a stand-down that Tavris Contair can record for review. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The stand-down is on record and the review afterward names what was done and what nobody could explain. Tavris Contair remembers who worked the crawl network under his doctrine and Torren Myralis remembers who carried the hurt. Damaged shell sections and drone losses stay until repaired by actual work; the threat category the layer answered is still unknown.

conditions.query: Tavren, Nessa or Maeron Halessin has told the player in person about the ruined commission being remade after hours and asked for help finishing it before the client returns.

effects.instruction: At The Apprentice Benches in The Red Forges, Tavren Halessin can offer this work during a direct conversation: Help finish the remade commission before the client returns and get the three Halessins to say their theories to each other. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The Halessins remember who worked the after-hours furnace with them and what each finally said about the ruin. The client has what was delivered and knows only what the family chose to tell. Whatever blame was taken or set down stays where the three of them put it; the Rivalry Yard learns of it only if someone talks.

conditions.query: A Dravon raid has actually struck Ignivex in play and Ilvara Meravil or Lysa Caldris has asked the player in person to help gather the household reports for the displacement count.

effects.instruction: At Ilvara’s Record Desk in Meravil Ash Hall, Ilvara Meravil can offer this work during a direct conversation: Gather the Hearth Rows household reports and see Ilvara Meravil's displacement count entered in the Casualty Record Chambers as the official record. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The Casualty Record Chambers hold the count as Ilvara entered it, with any annotations, and both Caldris shelters and Volen halls act on those numbers. Ilvara and Lysa remember who went door to door. Vennik remembers whether the player gave him the numbers early. The city's argument about surrender is unchanged and the count belongs to no side.

conditions.query: A pressure fault has actually opened in the Geothermal Core Facilities in play with a crew cut off, and Tharen Volen or Rava Caldris has enlisted the player.

effects.instruction: At Tharen’s Overseer Station in Geothermal Core Facilities, Tharen Volen can offer this work during a direct conversation: Reach the cut-off crew and help Tharen Volen contain the fault, then record with him what the Sabotage Watch Point actually showed. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Tharen Volen remembers who went into the Heat Tunnels with him and keeps the watch-point record exactly as written, wear, suspicion or unknown. Rava and Tessan Caldris remember the same. Burns heal at their own pace, the damaged conduits stay damaged until repaired, and if sabotage was suspected the city argues about it without proof.

conditions.query: Odrin Kathvar or Dalan Kathvar has told the player in person about the mishandled permit at the Ring Gate and asked for help carrying the correction to Jorek Kathvar.

effects.instruction: At The Civics Classrooms in The Gray Rings, Odrin Kathvar can offer this work during a direct conversation: Carry Dalan Kathvar's permit correction through to Jorek Kathvar's counter and see father and son settle it face to face. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The corrected file sits in the outer-ring record exactly as entered. Dalan remembers what his father said and Odrin remembers whether the player let Dalan carry it himself. Jorek remembers a name attached to a clean correction. No grade moved, no permit was granted that was not owed, and the Kathvar counters treat the player as someone who understands the paperwork.

conditions.query: Pelna Ostrek has told the player in person what her readings at the Engineer Stations say about the gate and asked for help verifying them and deciding the inspection report.

effects.instruction: At Quilrath Gate Yard in The Quilrath Gate, Pelna Ostrek can offer this work during a direct conversation: Verify Pelna Ostrek's gate readings and see the inspection report filed, withheld or amended as a recorded entry in the gate's inspection log. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The inspection log holds the entry as it was actually made and Pelna Ostrek lives with what it says about her. If the inspectors received the readings they hold them; if the report was withheld, Pelna and the player know it was. The gate is exactly as close to its last failure as before, and Tarsen Dravon knows who spent time at the Engineer Stations.

conditions.query: Cadi Selm has told the player in person that the Quiet Mile's schedule changed with a family already on the move and asked for help getting them through or back.

effects.instruction: At The Quiet Mile in The Southreach, Cadi Selm can offer this work during a direct conversation: Get Cadi Selm's family through the Quiet Mile or turned safely back, and establish what the changed schedule actually was. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

Cadi Selm and whichever Archive cell sent the family remember what the player did when the schedule was wrong. The family is where the run left them and that stands. Avrenna Volsk's sweep has a face in its notes if it saw one. The Quiet Mile's purchased schedule is still an arrangement and still uncertain; whether that night was a trap is known only if it was shown.

conditions.query: Sev Marrik, Mareva Marrik or Darven Marrik has told the player in person about the Korrvane tournament invitation and asked for help with the answer.

effects.instruction: At Sev's Roof Lane in Dustfall Residential Rows, Sev Marrik can offer this work during a direct conversation: Help Sev Marrik reach an actual answer to the Korrvane invitation and have Darven and Mareva Marrik hear it from him. Let the party accept or decline; an offer is not acceptance. Use the giver only if already present in the scene; never summon an absent giver or invent a runner, note, posting or rumor to deliver it. Do not resolve it this turn.

The weekly final is over and its result is a record now. Carry forward exactly what was ruled: the injuries, the treatment, the equipment damage, what the House Seating Tiers saw and what the commentary perches said. If the player won, the Genesis Ladder is a public choice still to be made; no title exists unless it was fought and ruled.

The Genesis Ladder attempt has ended as it was ruled. Alcandrus Genesis remains first. Whatever the player did on the ladder is now the thing people at the Arena say about them; treatment, expense and standing follow, and no rank or title comes from it unless a judge ruled one.

The Citadel returns to its business. Whatever Ark Genesis did with the friendly challenge is a public fact now, repeated with different emphasis by every House compound; Darkstar Castro's position is unchanged unless the Core Challenge Court ruled otherwise. Let people bring it up for their own reasons, not as news.

The ranked challenge is over and the irregularity is a question the Academy is asking quietly, not an answer. The defeated student keeps their real skill and their standing takes what the crowd gave it. Rumour about the bout is rumour; only what the player saw is theirs to know.

The Clean Exit was taken, refused or priced beyond reach, and the Ring remembers which. Varek Zelvaris keeps the sold match on his books either way. Whatever the player paid or promised is a debt on real terms that the Hollow Ring will collect in its own time.

The flagged weapon is where the peace station left it: surrendered, stored, escorted out of the city or returned at the line. The station's record carries the visitor's name. Solvraxis stays weapon-free by trust, and the person it happened to is a little more known here.

The grading dispute has a finding now, right or wrong, and the reference in the Sealed References is corrected or stands. Somebody lost credit and somebody kept it; the cargo went where the arbiter sent it. The Common Scale remembers who argued what in the open.

First Barge is over. Imma Dray's refusal stood or was bought around, and the leverage used against her is spent or still in someone's hand. Berth priority, the insurance flag and the route-boards show the result; the quays talk about it for a tenday.

The emergency is closed and the Ward-class drone's refusal is logged for Contair review. Whoever was saved or lost by that refusal is a fact of the city now. Rezulith's Workshop will decide what it means; nobody else's opinion changes the log.

The Smoke Court adjourned without finishing the argument, because Ignivex never finishes it. The casualty figures are on the Record Desk, Meravil's position is on the floor, and Volen's answer is the walls. Whatever the player said there is remembered by both sides.

The Festival Kiln has emptied and the Flame Dance Ring is cooling. Burns were treated, a young fighter's name is known one terrace further than it was, and the outsiders who underestimated the heat carry the lesson. Ordinary shifts resume in the morning.

The Curfew Gates are up again. The family is together or it is not, the marks are recorded against whoever was late, and Mirasha Kathvar used the margin inside the rule or did not. Nothing about Quilrath's rules changed; the people who were there know what they saw.

The reprisal list stands and the Archive families on it live with it. Ferrik Nivarek's office rebuilds its files. The Accord's two wings are still arguing about the strike and will not reconcile; whatever the player did placed them, in someone's file, on a side.

The warrant was refused, executed or quietly let lapse, and Dustfall remembers which and who stood where. Ravik Rusk's standing moved with it; the Claimants keep their own list. No warrant gained force here that it did not have before.

The Longburn storm has passed down the beacon line. Losses on the route are real and counted by the Vhaldrins at the Route Marker Post; the route reopens on their word. Sand is still in everything for days.

The node is destroyed or gone, and the crew's overdue member is dead and has been since before they walked in; nothing that happened changes that. The Handoff keeps its quarantine habits for a while. Nobody who saw the eyes talks about it lightly, and nobody mistakes the next late arrival for the living without looking twice.

A memory beat, not news: let one small consequence of something the player did earlier surface in the scene through a person or object that would plausibly carry it, a repaired thing still holding, a refused offer remembered, a name said back to them. No summons, no bulletin, nothing the character could not observe.

A memory beat: a face from an earlier scene reappears with their own business, not the player's, and treats the player exactly as their last exchange earned. Only if the place and timing make it plausible; otherwise let the beat pass.

A memory beat: something the player agreed to, owes or is owed comes due on its real terms, a shift, a payment, a return date, a repair guarantee. State it through the person who holds the other end, in their own words, once.

A memory beat: someone repeats a public fact about the player, accurate or slightly wrong in the way rumour is, and it has changed how one ordinary person treats them. Private facts stay private; only what was witnessed travels.

A memory beat: the season has visibly moved on since the story began; let one institution the player touched, a school, a workshop, a compound, a crew, show that time passed for it too, with a decision made or a face gone.
A memory beat: someone the player helped or refused has moved on with their life in a way that fits what happened, and it shows without being announced. The world kept score; do not tally it aloud.
A memory beat: a thread the player left open is quietly closed by other people, and the closing is visible where the player is. No failure entry unless a quest was actually accepted and abandoned.

A memory beat: an old debt, favour or refusal returns from far enough back that the player may have forgotten it, carried by the person who did not. Play it at the register of that person, not as a plot turn.

The player has now seen three pieces of agreed work through to their actual end. Let one person who was there for one of them say so, in their own terms, without a reward attached; competence gets noticed on Nexara before it gets paid.

Ten completed jobs is a reputation, not a title. Somewhere the player works, someone now asks for them by name, and somewhere else someone has decided what kind of person they are. Show one of each over the next scenes, never both at once.

Twenty-five completed jobs: the player is a fixture in the places they work, with the debts and expectations that come with it. Let an institution, not a person, treat them as known, a desk that stops checking, a queue that lets them through, a bill that assumes they will pay.

quilrath_arrest_detained.name: quilrath_arrest_detained

conditions.query: The player has been physically detained, restrained or taken into custody by Quilrath authorities — Accord operators, Redline, or civil enforcement — for a specific witnessed offense, and has not yet been processed

quilrath_arrest_detained.script: const _rg=String(check({type:'party-region'})||'');if(["The Black Star Rise", "Gateward Compound", "Bastion Hard", "The Outer Blockworks", "The Bridged Blocks", "The Gray Rings", "Terrace Row", "Dustward Edge", "The Curfew Corridors", "The Glass Rise", "The Glass Threshold", "The Numbered Streets", "The Scrub Margin", "The Ashring Stacks", "The Darkened Rows", "The Outer Yards", "The Patrol Runs", "The Camp Line", "The Faded Blocks", "Southreach Edge", "The Boundary Line"].indexOf(_rg)<0){skip=true;}

effects.instruction: The player has been detained by Quilrath authorities. Processing follows the city's system: identity confirmation against the Accord ledger, the offense recorded with witnesses named, the detainee's grade checked. Detention is administrative before it is punitive — the operator files the report, a supervisor reviews it, and the outcome depends on the offense and the player's existing record. Possible outcomes in ascending severity: immediate release with a recorded mark; a formal warning that affects the next audit; temporary confinement in a holding block (hours to days); grade reduction; extended confinement with restricted movement and supervised work assignment; or transfer to Bastion Hard for serious offenses. The player's grade, prior marks, family connections on the rows and the specific offense all affect the outcome. Detention is not a death sentence or a disappearance — families can inquire, the process has steps, and the Accord's own regulations constrain it.

conditions.query: The detained player has been formally processed — the offense has been reviewed by a supervisor, a decision has been made, and the outcome has been communicated to the player

effects.instruction: Processing is complete. The outcome has been decided and recorded. If released: the player returns to their registered address or designated area with the mark on their file. If confined: they are moved to the appropriate holding facility — a ward block for short confinement, Bastion Hard for extended sentences. Confinement means restricted movement, supervised meal access, assigned work duties appropriate to the facility, and a review date. The player keeps their identity and their relationships but loses free movement. Family and known associates may be notified through the standard process. Contraband is confiscated; personal effects are inventoried.

conditions.query: The player is currently confined in a Quilrath holding facility or work assignment and a new day or shift has begun

effects.instruction: Another period of confinement. The routine is real: wake call, supervised wash, meal queue at the ward canteen, assigned work duty, supervised yard time if earned, evening count. The work assignment matches the facility — sorting, cleaning, maintenance, material processing, records filing. Guards are operators doing a rotation, not personal enemies. Other confined people have their own offenses, grades and attitudes. Time passes and the review date approaches. Play the confinement as a real environment with choices: cooperation, resistance, alliances, information, trade in small comforts, and the question of what the player does when the routine offers a gap. When the confinement counter reaches zero, the review is due.

conditions.query: The player's confinement review date has arrived and they are brought before the reviewing authority

effects.instruction: Confinement review. A supervisor and a records clerk assess the file: the original offense, behavior during confinement, work reports, any new incidents, the player's grade and current marks. Outcomes: release to registered address with continuing supervision; release with grade adjustment; extended confinement if behavior warrants it; or, for a Grade 5 resident, transfer to permanent assignment in the outer facilities. The review is procedural — it follows the file, and the player's conduct during confinement is the strongest factor they control. An advocate or family member may speak if present and permitted.

conditions.query: The player's accumulated marks have triggered an automatic grade review and the audit has formally lowered their standing

effects.instruction: Grade lowered. The accumulated marks triggered the review and the result is recorded. The practical effects are immediate: different queues, different ring-gate access, different audit frequency, different shelf at the Provision Hall. Neighbors notice. Family on the rows feels it. The people's name for the new grade is what matters on the street, not the number.

conditions.query: The player reads, browses or asks about the bounty board or posted contracts at the Public Contract Hall

effects.instruction: The Public Contract Hall's bounty board has new postings. Generate a creature bounty appropriate to the Relstaris region, naming one of Nexara's ten authored fauna within its established range (Ridgewing, Dustrunner, Ventcrawler, Longreach Lurker, Glassmidge Swarm, Fieldmoth Swarm, Slowhide Grazer, Trailhound, Eavesdart or Tideclaw; never an invented creature) — something threatening trade routes, farmland, or the outskirts. The posting names the creature type, last known location, the threat it poses, a reward in Nexaran Credits the poster sets from the local price anchors for the danger and work, not from the player's level, and a contact to report to. Western Nexara's threats are wildlife and territorial predators, not political targets. The board also shows older completed and expired postings to make it feel lived-in.

conditions.query: The player reads, browses or asks about the bounty board or posted contracts at the Civic Peace Stations

effects.instruction: The Civic Peace Stations maintain a public bounty board. Generate a creature bounty appropriate to the Solvraxis region, naming one of Nexara's ten authored fauna within its established range (Ridgewing, Dustrunner, Ventcrawler, Longreach Lurker, Glassmidge Swarm, Fieldmoth Swarm, Slowhide Grazer, Trailhound, Eavesdart or Tideclaw; never an invented creature) — something from the western wilderness encroaching on the city's gravitically maintained perimeter, or threatening travellers on approach routes. Solvraxis postings are formal and precise: creature type, behavioral pattern observed, risk assessment, recommended approach, a reward in Nexaran Credits the poster sets from the local price anchors for the danger and work, not from the player's level, and the civic officer to report to. The board reflects Solvraxis's orderly culture.

conditions.query: The player reads, browses or asks about the bounty board or posted contracts on the Traveller Orientation Deck

effects.instruction: The Traveller Orientation Deck at Helvyra's Lunar Gate Hub maintains a bounty board for travellers passing through. Generate a creature bounty appropriate to the Helvyra region, naming one of Nexara's ten authored fauna within its established range (Ridgewing, Dustrunner, Ventcrawler, Longreach Lurker, Glassmidge Swarm, Fieldmoth Swarm, Slowhide Grazer, Trailhound, Eavesdart or Tideclaw; never an invented creature) — something threatening the gate approaches, the transit corridors, or the surrounding terrain. Helvyra is a transit hub so postings come from multiple sources: local authorities, transit companies, and traveller cooperatives. The posting names the creature, location, threat, a reward in Nexaran Credits the poster sets from the local price anchors for the danger and work, not from the player's level, and who to report to. Some postings are from other cities, routed through the hub.

conditions.query: The player reads, browses or asks about the official postings and wanted notices on The Victory Walk

effects.instruction: Quilrath's Victory Walk displays official wanted notices — not creature bounties but persons. Generate a wanted-person bounty appropriate to Quilrath's authoritarian grading system: a fugitive who fled a grade demotion, someone who evaded a curfew audit, a suspected Accord operative, a person whose Standing review was flagged, or a figure wanted for undermining civic compliance. The posting is formal Dravon-administered language: subject description, last known location, offence classification, grade status, a reward in Nexaran Credits the poster sets from the local price anchors for the danger and work, not from the player's level, and the compliance office to report to. Quilrath bounties are political — the target may not deserve what Quilrath wants to do to them. The player can take the bounty, warn the target, or ignore it.

conditions.query: The player reads, browses or asks about the bounties and wanted notices at the Direct Complaint Desk

effects.instruction: The Direct Complaint Desk at the Volen Compound maintains Ignivex's bounty board. Generate a bounty appropriate to Ignivex's situation: a Dravon operative spotted near the border, a minor Quilrath house agent conducting unauthorized surveys on Ignivex territory, a Redline scout, or someone connected to the encroachment Cynar Volen has been fighting politically. Ignivex bounties are defensive — protecting territory from outside threats. The posting names the target or target type, last known sighting, the threat they pose to Ignivex, a reward in Nexaran Credits the poster sets from the local price anchors for the danger and work, not from the player's level, and the Volen security officer to report to. Some bounties are capture-preferred — Ignivex wants intelligence, not just elimination.

conditions.query: The player reads, browses or asks about the jobs, bounties and contracts posted on the Informal Job Rail

effects.instruction: Dustfall's Informal Job Rail is the bounty board — nails, tape, handwritten cards, some printed. Everything goes up here. Generate a bounty from any category: a creature (one of the ten authored fauna within its range: Ridgewing, Dustrunner, Ventcrawler, Longreach Lurker, Glassmidge Swarm, Fieldmoth Swarm, Slowhide Grazer, Trailhound, Eavesdart or Tideclaw; never invented) threatening the perimeter or the longburn routes, a wanted person who fled another city's justice, a salvage job in dangerous terrain, a cargo escort through hostile wildlife territory, a missing person search, or a straight fight contract. Dustfall does not filter. The posting quality varies — some are formal contracts with clear terms, others are desperate handwritten notes. Rewards come from the poster and the local price anchors, not the player's level; some offer trade goods or favors instead. The contact is whoever posted it — no civic office, just a name and a location in the settlement.
