Civic neighborhood.name: Civic neighborhood
Civic neighborhood.description:
you grew up in a community-oriented setting: shared errands, familiar neighbours and everyday social routines. You learned to read people, mediate small disputes and keep a household running smoothly.

This is your raised background, separate from your faction or current life. The skills you picked up are social and practical, not professional.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Charisma; +5 Hospitality, +5 Mediation.
Civic neighborhood.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up surrounded by neighbours and community routines. They know how to navigate casual social situations, introduce themselves comfortably and read the mood of a room. Small-scale mediation and hospitality come naturally — they have hosted guests, settled minor disagreements and organised shared events. Their social instincts are practical, not political. They default to neighbourly trust but recognise when someone does not fit the local pattern.

Workshop household.name: Workshop household
Workshop household.description:
you grew up around tools, repairs and supervised bench work. Fixing things, inspecting parts and understanding how objects are assembled was part of daily life.

This is your raised background, separate from any professional training. You have practical hands and an eye for how things fit together, even if you never completed a formal apprenticeship.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Intellect; +5 Assembly, +5 Inspection.
Workshop household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up handling tools and watching repairs. They instinctively check how things are put together, notice when a fastener is wrong or a joint is stressed, and feel comfortable picking up unfamiliar hand tools. Their understanding is practical and tactile — they learn by taking things apart, not from manuals. They keep a tidy workspace by habit and treat borrowed tools with care.

Service household.name: Service household
Service household.description:
you grew up in a home where guests were regular and practical care was routine. Hospitality, housekeeping and attending to other people's needs were everyday expectations.

This is your raised background, separate from any current employment. You know how to make people comfortable, anticipate needs and manage a household efficiently.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Charisma; +5 Hospitality, +5 Housekeeping.
Service household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up serving and hosting. They read body language for comfort or distress, anticipate what a guest needs before being asked, and maintain clean, organised spaces by reflex. They are comfortable in formal service situations and know the difference between attentive and intrusive. Their care instincts extend to practical tasks — clean linens, prepared food, a room made ready.

Academic household.name: Academic household
Academic household.description:
you grew up surrounded by books, questions and ordinary learning. Curiosity, reading and structured thinking were household values, even without any formal institutional degree.

This is your raised background, separate from any current studies. You are comfortable with research, focused reading and following a line of inquiry to its conclusion.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Intellect; +5 Research, +5 Concentration.
Academic household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up in a home that valued learning. They are comfortable with extended reading, take notes by habit, and approach unfamiliar subjects by looking for structure and first principles. They ask clarifying questions naturally and can hold a line of thought through interruptions. Their learning style is self-directed — they know how to find information even when no teacher is available.

Trade and port household.name: Trade and port household
Trade and port household.description:
you grew up around supplies, routes and exchanges. Cargo, logistics, bargaining and the rhythm of shipments coming and going were part of daily life.

This is your raised background, separate from any current trade position. You understand how goods move, what things cost and how to negotiate a fair exchange.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Bargaining, +5 Logistics.
Trade and port household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up around commerce and shipping. They estimate quantities by eye, recognise common trade goods and packaging, and understand the basics of supply, demand and transit timing. Haggling feels natural and they spot inflated prices or suspicious deals quickly. They are comfortable in busy market or port environments and can navigate the social dynamics of traders, brokers and dock workers.

Agrarian household.name: Agrarian household
Agrarian household.description:
you grew up with seasonal work, known crops and the rhythms of cultivation. Planting, harvesting, preserving food and reading weather were part of your daily routine.

This is your raised background, separate from any current occupation. You understand growing cycles, soil and food preservation, and you are comfortable with sustained physical work outdoors.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Endurance; +5 Cultivation, +5 Food Preservation.
Agrarian household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up working land or managed growing environments. They read weather instinctively, know when soil or a growing medium is healthy, and can preserve food through multiple methods. Their endurance comes from seasons of repetitive physical work. They are practical about food — they know what is in season, what keeps, and how to make a meal stretch. They notice changes in natural environments that city-raised characters miss.

Remote settlement.name: Remote settlement
Remote settlement.description:
you grew up in a small, isolated community where self-reliance was essential. Local terrain, shelter construction and long-distance hiking were necessary life skills, not hobbies.

This is your raised background, separate from any current location. You are comfortable in rough terrain, know how to build or maintain basic shelter, and can navigate without established routes.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Endurance; +5 Hiking, +5 Sheltercraft.
Remote settlement.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up far from major population centres. They are comfortable with physical isolation, can navigate rough terrain by landmark, and know how to construct or repair basic shelter from available materials. They are self-reliant by necessity — used to solving problems with whatever is at hand. They may be less comfortable in crowded urban environments but read natural terrain and weather intuitively.

Performance household.name: Performance household
Performance household.description:
you grew up with music, rehearsal and shared performance as household routine. You actually learned an instrument and participated in planning and staging events.

This is your raised background, separate from any professional performance career. You are comfortable on stage, understand rehearsal discipline and know how to coordinate a group effort.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Presence; +5 Musicianship, +5 Event Planning.
Performance household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up performing. They are comfortable being watched, can project their voice, and understand timing, cues and the flow of an audience's attention. They know at least one instrument or performance discipline well enough to practice independently. Group coordination — setting up a space, managing a programme, adjusting to a live audience — comes naturally. They read a crowd's mood and energy.

Caregiving household.name: Caregiving household
Caregiving household.description:
you grew up providing practical care for others within your species' knowledge. First aid, attentive observation and household management were everyday responsibilities.

This is your raised background, separate from any medical or professional training. You notice when someone is unwell, know basic aid techniques and keep a household safe and functional.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 First Aid, +5 Housekeeping.
Caregiving household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up caring for people. They notice signs of illness, fatigue or distress before others do, and their first instinct is to help rather than observe. They know basic wound care, can manage medication schedules and keep a living space clean and safe. Their awareness is people-focused — they track who has eaten, who is tired, who is avoiding a conversation. They remain calm in minor emergencies.

Competitive household.name: Competitive household
Competitive household.description:
you grew up with structured practice, physical competition and the discipline of training regularly. Sport, contests and self-improvement were household values.

This is your raised background, separate from any professional athletic career. You understand training regimens, can push through fatigue and know both how to win and how to lose.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Strength; +5 Running, +5 Concentration.
Competitive household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up competing. They understand warm-up routines, structured practice and the difference between training effort and performance effort. They handle pressure well, can pace themselves through sustained physical activity, and respect rules and fair play by instinct. They know how to assess an opponent's readiness and adjust their own approach. Losing is familiar and does not break their composure.

Displaced household.name: Displaced household
Displaced household.description:
you grew up adapting to a place that was not originally home. Your family or guardians were rebuilding — learning new systems, new neighbours and new rules while preserving what they could of where they came from.

This is your raised background, separate from your current stability. You are observant, resourceful and comfortable navigating unfamiliar situations.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Inspection, +5 Bargaining.
Displaced household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up navigating displacement. They are alert to social cues that signal whether they are welcome, tolerated or unwanted. They adapt quickly to new environments, learn local rules fast and are resourceful with limited resources. They may carry habits from a previous home that do not quite fit the current one. Their resilience is practical — they have rebuilt before and know how to start over.

Technical habitat household.name: Technical habitat household
Technical habitat household.description:
you grew up dependent on maintained infrastructure: life support, power systems, water recycling or atmospheric management. Understanding how your home worked was not optional.

This is your raised background, separate from any engineering career. You notice when systems are running normally and when something has changed, and you understand scheduled maintenance as a fact of life.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Intellect; +5 Maintenance Planning, +5 Inspection.
Technical habitat household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up in a technically sustained environment. They notice system sounds, pressure changes and indicator lights without conscious effort. Scheduled maintenance is routine, not an emergency — they understand that infrastructure requires constant attention. They are comfortable reading basic system status displays and know when to report a change versus when to fix it themselves. They instinctively conserve shared resources.

Student.name: Student
Student.description:
Currently enrolled in formal or informal study, building foundational knowledge before committing to a specific profession.

Starting skills: Research +10, Concentration +5, Writing +5. Retains existing aptitude bonus. No employer, wage, or professional equipment from this role — you are still learning the basics and exploring your interests.
Student.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is a student — someone still in their studies who has not yet entered a profession. They have basic academic skills but no professional training or workplace authority. Describe their actual study context: what they are learning, where, and under whose guidance. They have no employer, professional tools, or occupational income. Their research and concentration skills reflect classroom learning, not practical expertise.

Apprentice.name: Apprentice
Apprentice.description:
Learning a trade through hands-on supervised work, building practical skills under a more experienced professional.

Starting skills: Assembly +10, Inspection +5, Repair Planning +5. Retains existing aptitude bonus. No employer, wage, or independent authority — you are training under supervision and cannot yet work unsupervised.
Apprentice.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is an apprentice — someone learning a trade through practical, supervised work rather than formal study. They have basic hands-on skills but work only under direction. Describe their actual apprenticeship: what trade, under whom, and what level of trust they have earned so far. They cannot take on independent jobs, make professional decisions alone, or claim expertise. Their skills reflect guided practice, not mastery.

Between roles.name: Between roles
Between roles.description:
Not currently employed or studying, but carrying general practical skills from prior life experience.

Starting skills: Inspection +10, Housekeeping +5, Bargaining +5. Retains existing aptitude bonus. No employer, wage, or professional equipment — you are currently unoccupied and relying on everyday life skills.
Between roles.traitNarrativeEffects: This character is between roles — not currently working or studying in any formal capacity. They have basic life skills from general experience but no active professional identity. Describe their actual situation: recently left a position, taking time between commitments, or simply not yet started working. They have no employer, workplace, professional tools, or occupational income. Their skills are from everyday life, not professional training.

Household caregiver.name: Household caregiver
Household caregiver.description:
Experienced in maintaining a home and caring for its occupants — cleaning, organizing, basic health monitoring, and keeping daily life running smoothly. A practiced caregiver knows how to manage a household independently and handle minor medical situations.

🎯 Skills: Housekeeping +20, First Aid +10, Hospitality +10. Awareness +1.
Choose the *In training* version if your character is a beginner or still learning.
Household caregiver.traitNarrativeEffects: This character has real experience managing a household: cleaning, organizing, basic medical response, and day-to-day care for residents. The listed skill bonuses (Housekeeping +20, First Aid +10, Hospitality +10) and Awareness +1 come directly from this selection. Overlapping sources add their modifiers; no double-counting. No employer, wage, equipment, license, or unrestricted authority is automatically granted — describe the actual workplace, status (current, former, or on leave), and specialty. Age alone does not prove work experience.

Hospitality worker.name: Hospitality worker
Hospitality worker.description:
Experienced in guest services, event coordination, and creating welcoming environments — whether in an inn, social hall, or private estate. A practiced hospitality worker reads social cues, manages spaces for comfort, and handles event logistics.

🎯 Skills: Hospitality +20, Housekeeping +10, Event Planning +10. Charisma +1.
Choose the *In training* version if your character is a beginner or still learning.
Hospitality worker.traitNarrativeEffects: This character has real experience guest-facing service work: hosting, event coordination, social management, and maintaining welcoming spaces. The listed skill bonuses (Hospitality +20, Housekeeping +10, Event Planning +10) and Charisma +1 come directly from this selection. Overlapping sources add their modifiers; no double-counting. No employer, wage, equipment, license, or unrestricted authority is automatically granted — describe the actual workplace, status (current, former, or on leave), and specialty. Age alone does not prove work experience.

Cook.name: Cook
Cook.description:
Experienced in preparing meals at a professional level — understanding ingredients, timing, food safety, and kitchen management. A practiced cook can feed groups efficiently and adapt recipes to available supplies and dietary needs.

🎯 Skills: Cooking +20, Food Preservation +10, Food Testing +10. Intellect +1.
Choose the *In training* version if your character is a beginner or still learning.
Cook.traitNarrativeEffects: This character has real experience professional food preparation: kitchen work, ingredient management, food safety testing, and meal production. The listed skill bonuses (Cooking +20, Food Preservation +10, Food Testing +10) and Intellect +1 come directly from this selection. Overlapping sources add their modifiers; no double-counting. No employer, wage, equipment, license, or unrestricted authority is automatically granted — describe the actual workplace, status (current, former, or on leave), and specialty. Age alone does not prove work experience.

Cyrra brewer.name: Cyrra brewer
Cyrra brewer.description:
Experienced in brewing cyrra, the widely consumed stimulant drink central to social and commercial life across Nexara. A practiced brewer understands fermentation timing, flavor profiles, serving etiquette, and quality assessment.

🎯 Skills: Cyrra Brewing +20, Hospitality +10, Food Testing +10. Awareness +1.
Choose the *In training* version if your character is a beginner or still learning.
Cyrra brewer.traitNarrativeEffects: This character has real experience cyrra production: brewing the signature stimulant drink, managing fermentation, hospitality service, and quality testing. The listed skill bonuses (Cyrra Brewing +20, Hospitality +10, Food Testing +10) and Awareness +1 come directly from this selection. Overlapping sources add their modifiers; no double-counting. No employer, wage, equipment, license, or unrestricted authority is automatically granted — describe the actual workplace, status (current, former, or on leave), and specialty. Age alone does not prove work experience.

Grower.name: Grower
Grower.description:
Experienced in cultivating crops and managing growing operations — soil preparation, planting cycles, water management, and harvest preservation. A practiced grower can sustain food production through seasonal changes and resource constraints.

🎯 Skills: Cultivation +20, Irrigation +10, Food Preservation +10. Endurance +1.
Choose the *In training* version if your character is a beginner or still learning.
Grower.traitNarrativeEffects: This character has real experience agricultural work: crop cultivation, irrigation management, seasonal planning, and food preservation for storage. The listed skill bonuses (Cultivation +20, Irrigation +10, Food Preservation +10) and Endurance +1 come directly from this selection. Overlapping sources add their modifiers; no double-counting. No employer, wage, equipment, license, or unrestricted authority is automatically granted — describe the actual workplace, status (current, former, or on leave), and specialty. Age alone does not prove work experience.

Fisher.name: Fisher
Fisher.description:
Experienced in harvesting aquatic resources — reading water conditions, managing equipment, and preserving catches for transport or sale. A practiced fisher works with weather patterns and understands marine or freshwater ecosystems.

🎯 Skills: Fishing +20, Weather Reading +10, Food Preservation +10. Awareness +1.
Choose the *In training* version if your character is a beginner or still learning.
Fisher.traitNarrativeEffects: This character has real experience aquatic harvesting: fishing technique, weather reading, catch preservation, and working with water conditions. you tend to pause before reacting. In tense situations, your instinct is to slow down, assess and respond deliberately rather than act on the first impulse.
