Battlefield Composure.name: Battlefield Composure
Battlefield Composure.description: 🎯 Composure under combat pressure. +5 Tactics, +5 Perception.
Battlefield Composure.traitNarrativeEffects: Trained ability to remain calm, observe, and decide under immediate physical threat.

Defensive Reading.name: Defensive Reading
Defensive Reading.description: 🎯 Reading an opponent's intent. +5 Blocking, +5 Perception.
Defensive Reading.traitNarrativeEffects: Practiced ability to read an opponent's preparatory movements and anticipate strikes before they commit.

Strike Discipline.name: Strike Discipline
Strike Discipline.traitNarrativeEffects: Trained discipline to deliver force precisely where intended with minimum wasted motion.

Endurance Conditioning.name: Endurance Conditioning
Endurance Conditioning.traitNarrativeEffects: Conditioned stamina that sustains effort through extended physical demands.

Quick Recovery Protocol.name: Quick Recovery Protocol
Quick Recovery Protocol.description: 🎯 Fast bounce-back from hits. +5 First Aid, +5 Concentration.
Quick Recovery Protocol.traitNarrativeEffects: Practiced ability to recover functional capacity quickly after taking damage.

Adaptive Engagement.name: Adaptive Engagement
Adaptive Engagement.traitNarrativeEffects: Ability to abandon a failing approach and switch to a better one without losing momentum.

Targeted Precision.name: Targeted Precision
Targeted Precision.description: 🎯 Aiming for structural weak points. +5 Striking, +5 Inspection.
Targeted Precision.traitNarrativeEffects: Trained eye for identifying and exploiting structural vulnerabilities in armor, equipment, or stance.

Group Combat Awareness.name: Group Combat Awareness
Group Combat Awareness.traitNarrativeEffects: Ability to monitor multiple threats simultaneously and position accordingly.

Pain Tolerance.name: Pain Tolerance
Pain Tolerance.traitNarrativeEffects: Practiced ability to continue operating despite active pain and accumulated damage.

Nonlethal Control.name: Nonlethal Control
Nonlethal Control.traitNarrativeEffects: Discipline to end a fight through restraint rather than destruction, maintaining control while minimizing harm.

Diplomatic Bearing.name: Diplomatic Bearing
Diplomatic Bearing.traitNarrativeEffects: Trained composure that holds under hostile negotiation, public challenge, and deliberate provocation.

Authority Projection.name: Authority Projection
Authority Projection.description: 💬 Commanding respect through presence. +5 Leadership, +5 Intimidation.
Authority Projection.traitNarrativeEffects: Bearing that communicates authority and decisiveness, earning compliance before words are spent.

Social Perception.name: Social Perception
Social Perception.description: 💬 Reading a room's dynamics. +5 Perception, +5 Diplomacy.
Social Perception.traitNarrativeEffects: Ability to perceive unspoken alliances, tensions, and agendas in a social gathering.

Network Cultivation.name: Network Cultivation
Network Cultivation.traitNarrativeEffects: Practiced habit of building and maintaining a network of reliable contacts across institutions and districts.

House Fluency.name: House Fluency
House Fluency.traitNarrativeEffects: Functional understanding of house protocols, rivalries, and unwritten rules that govern political interaction.

Urban Orientation.name: Urban Orientation
Urban Orientation.traitNarrativeEffects: Familiarity with the city's structure — districts, transit, shortcuts, dead ends — that keeps movement efficient.

Emergency Treatment.name: Emergency Treatment
Emergency Treatment.description: 🏙️ Stabilizing injuries in the field. +5 First Aid, +5 Triage.
Emergency Treatment.traitNarrativeEffects: Practiced ability to stabilize critical injuries with available materials before proper care arrives.

Technical Aptitude.name: Technical Aptitude
Technical Aptitude.description: 🏙️ Basic repair and maintenance. +5 Mechanics, +5 Repair Planning.
Technical Aptitude.traitNarrativeEffects: Functional understanding of how common equipment, systems, and structures are built and maintained.

Investigative Method.name: Investigative Method
Investigative Method.traitNarrativeEffects: Systematic approach to following evidence, connecting observations, and reconstructing sequences of events.

Archival Competence.name: Archival Competence
Archival Competence.traitNarrativeEffects: Ability to locate, retrieve, and interpret records across the city's documentation systems.

Affinity Refinement.name: Affinity Refinement
Affinity Refinement.description: ✨ Finer control of personal expression. +5 Affinity Control, +5 Concentration.
Affinity Refinement.traitNarrativeEffects: Deepened control over the user's innate expression, allowing finer gradations and more sustained output.

Channeling Endurance.name: Channeling Endurance
Channeling Endurance.traitNarrativeEffects: Trained ability to maintain a working at full effectiveness over extended periods without degradation.

Working Discipline.name: Working Discipline
Working Discipline.description: ✨ Preventing magical accidents. +5 Field Perception, +5 Inscription.
Working Discipline.traitNarrativeEffects: Rigorous safety habits that prevent working failures, contamination, and uncontrolled discharge.

Field Awareness.name: Field Awareness
Field Awareness.description: ✨ Perceiving active workings nearby. +5 Field Perception, +5 Arcane Detection.
Field Awareness.traitNarrativeEffects: Trained sensitivity to active workings, residual inscriptions, and latent fields in the immediate environment.

Crisis Decision.name: Crisis Decision
Crisis Decision.description: ⚡ Making calls under pressure. +5 Leadership, +5 Tactics.
Crisis Decision.traitNarrativeEffects: Ability to assess, decide, and commit under time pressure without freezing or second-guessing.

Mentorship Practice.name: Mentorship Practice
Mentorship Practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Practiced ability to identify what someone is doing wrong and communicate the correction clearly.

Professional Standard.name: Professional Standard
Professional Standard.description: ⚡ Higher quality in craft work. +5 Inspection, +5 Concentration.
Professional Standard.traitNarrativeEffects: Internalized standard of work quality that catches errors before they leave the bench.

Operational Awareness.name: Operational Awareness
Operational Awareness.traitNarrativeEffects: Ability to track multiple moving parts, delegate effectively, and maintain operational coherence under pressure.

Resource Efficiency.name: Resource Efficiency
Resource Efficiency.traitNarrativeEffects: Practical habit of stretching resources, substituting materials, and planning consumption against actual need.

Restraint Under Provocation.name: Restraint Under Provocation
Restraint Under Provocation.description: ⚡ Maintaining control when tested. +5 Concentration, +5 Diplomacy.
Restraint Under Provocation.traitNarrativeEffects: Disciplined refusal to be baited into rash action by insult, threat, or deliberate escalation.

[Title] Korrvane Bracket Contender.name: [Title] Korrvane Bracket Contender
[Title] Korrvane Bracket Contender.description: 🏆 Qualified into Korrvane's thirty-two-competitor Weekly Bracket at least once.
[Title] Korrvane Bracket Contender.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder has passed identity verification, safety and medical clearance and equipment inspection, and won or been placed through a district or open-entry qualifier into the public main bracket of Korrvane's Weekly Bracket. Registrars, judges and bookmakers in Korrvane know the name; the Local Bracket Displays have shown it. Minor-house contenders treat the holder as a real entrant rather than a spectator, and qualifier performance can earn seeding consideration in later cycles without guaranteeing a slot. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Title] Korrvane Weekly Champion.name: [Title] Korrvane Weekly Champion
[Title] Korrvane Weekly Champion.description: 🏆 Won a Korrvane weekly final; the name is on the Victory Wall.
[Title] Korrvane Weekly Champion.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder won the weekly final of Korrvane's public main bracket in a bout decided by surrender, incapacitation, ring or airspace conditions, technical stoppage or judge ruling, and completed the winner's obligations: appearing before the judges, publicly accepting or declining the Genesis Ladder, attending medical review and standing for the official record. The name is on the Victory Wall with the cycle it was won. In Korrvane this is the highest sanctioned result short of the ladder: it changes invitations, sponsorship interest, training access, district doors, political meetings and crowd reaction, and it is remembered alongside how the holder won and how they lost afterwards. A champion does not defend the result; the next cycle's bracket is open again, and standing is social and cumulative, never a number anyone quotes. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Title] Genesis Ladder Challenger.name: [Title] Genesis Ladder Challenger
[Title] Genesis Ladder Challenger.description: 🏆 Made a certified Genesis Ladder attempt as a weekly champion.
[Title] Genesis Ladder Challenger.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder, as a certified weekly champion, publicly accepted the Genesis Ladder and fought Alcandrus Genesis, the ladder's permanent first gatekeeper, in the Genesis Ladder Staging Area under the judges' conditions. The attempt is recorded on the Victory Wall whatever its result, and a clean loss to Alcandrus is the normal outcome, not a disgrace. The crowd's silence during an attempt is a form of respect; the city remembers who forced Alcandrus to prepare, who surprised him, and who made excuses. House Genesis respects honest challenge and remembers it. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Title] Beyond the First Gate.name: [Title] Beyond the First Gate
[Title] Beyond the First Gate.description: 🏆 Defeated Alcandrus Genesis in a certified ladder attempt. No minor-house champion has ever done this.
[Title] Beyond the First Gate.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder did what Korrvane's record says has never been done: passed the ladder's first gatekeeper in a certified attempt. Nina Castro was waved past by Tacitus; she did not defeat him. What happens next is not a numbered ranking: Tacitus and Corvinus Genesis decide which Genesis members, if any, form a further stage, whether that stage is ceremonial, technical or fully competitive, and under what safety terms, weighing the champion's condition and collateral risk. Alcandrus adds the name to a private accounting. The result becomes city history within the day, reaches every minor house, and reshapes how Barcavon Zelvaris and every serious contender read the impossible standard. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Title] Highfire Grand Bracket Champion.name: [Title] Highfire Grand Bracket Champion
[Title] Highfire Grand Bracket Champion.description: 🏆 Won the Highfire Grand Bracket, the tournament season's culminating final in Korrvane.
[Title] Highfire Grand Bracket Champion.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder won the final of the Grand Bracket in Highfire's last tenday, the cycle in which Korrvane's tournament season culminates: open-entry qualifiers swell with visiting fighters from other cities, the House Seating Tiers are full, the Bracket Supply Market and Betting Stands run at their peak and the winner's obligations are the same as any weekly champion's, including the public ladder decision. The Victory Wall records Grand Bracket champions with the year. Across Nexara this is the result most likely to be known outside Korrvane. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Title] Aerial Ring Victor.name: [Title] Aerial Ring Victor
[Title] Aerial Ring Victor.description: 🏆 Won a declared aerial contest judged in the Aerial Ring or a Challenge Lane of Korrvane.
[Title] Aerial Ring Victor.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder won a declared, judged aerial contest in Korrvane: an Aerial Ring bout, a race or a movement challenge run inside a marked Challenge Lane under lane etiquette, with a judge or official present and civilians out of the volume. House Aevon, which performs especially well in the Aerial Ring, notices such results; Gisqon Aevon and the flight-lane instructors know the name. Racing or fighting in Transit Lanes or gate approach airspace is never a contest and never earns this. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Title] Academy Challenge Ring Ranked.name: [Title] Academy Challenge Ring Ranked
[Title] Academy Challenge Ring Ranked.description: 🏆 Entered in the student rankings after an approved challenge in the Public Challenge Ring of Relstaris Academy.
[Title] Academy Challenge Ring Ranked.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder, as a registered student of the capitol's academy, won an approved student challenge in the Public Challenge Ring of the Academy Affinity and Combat Campus and was entered in the campus rankings. The Academy is not a smaller Korrvane: rankings are internal, sponsors may not publicly claim participants in the Unranked Exhibition, high-level assessments run on the Closed Examination Floor away from spectators and bookmakers, and betting on student matches is illegal. Aurex Genesis and the instructors treat the result as information about what to teach next, not a crown. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Title] Blade Courts Graded.name: [Title] Blade Courts Graded
[Title] Blade Courts Graded.description: 🏆 Passed a formal grading at the Blade Courts of Rux Corsair's Sword School in Helvyra.
[Title] Blade Courts Graded.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder passed a formal grading in the Wayline sword tradition before Rux Corsair's instructors at the Blade Courts, with families and visiting duellists watching as they do. A grading is a recognition of technique and conduct within the school, not a rank in House Corsair, not a licence to teach, and not a tournament result; the Blade Courts also carry authority in matters of honour, so a graded student is expected to keep the school's conduct in any public challenge. Vaelor Corsair and Seryn Corsair know the name; House Veltrax notices. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. [Title] Redcourt Challenge Victor.name: [Title] Redcourt Challenge Victor
[Title] Redcourt Challenge Victor.description: 🏆 Won a formal public challenge on the Public Challenge Floor of the Veltrax Redcourt District.
[Title] Redcourt Challenge Victor.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder won a formal, declared public challenge on the Public Challenge Floor of the Veltrax Redcourt District under House Veltrax's conditions, with the Instructor Gallery watching and the result noted at the Trophy Wall. Veltrax challenges are aggressive, proud and formal, never lawless; a win here earns respect from Arvessa Veltrax's school and attention from Rux Corsair's students across the river, especially if the winner fights in a Corsair style. It is not a tournament title and confers no standing in Korrvane. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Title] The Hollow Champion.name: [Title] The Hollow Champion
[Title] The Hollow Champion.description: 🏆 Called the Hollow Champion after winning the headline match of the capitol's illegal ring.
[Title] The Hollow Champion.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder won the main match at the Hollow Ring in Low Relstaris, the illegal combat district run by Varek Zelvaris, where fixed matches, debt fights and forbidden conditions are ordinary. The name is not a title any institution recognises: it is what the Ring's crowd and Ruin Board call the holder. It brings money, offers from the Recruitment Balcony and the attention of people who fix outcomes; it also brings Kira Dorr's investigations, Valerius Genesis's enforcement decisions, disqualification from Academy competition if discovered, and suspicion at any sanctioned registration desk that checks records. Winning here does not replace Korrvane's public tournament culture and earns nothing on the Victory Wall. A title is a record of a result actually fought and ruled in play; it is never proclaimed, bought, inherited or granted by a trainer, sponsor or House. It grants no House membership, rank, credential, ability, payment or access by itself; what it changes is how people who follow the circuit treat the holder. Famous competitors keep their real skill regardless of who holds what.

[Mark] Suspended from the Bracket.name: [Mark] Suspended from the Bracket
[Mark] Suspended from the Bracket.description: ⛔ Removed from Korrvane's bracket by the judges or medics; cannot register until cleared.
[Mark] Suspended from the Bracket.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder is currently suspended from sanctioned competition in Korrvane: disqualified for undeclared equipment, civilian endangerment, attacking outside the declared combat space, continuing after a medical stoppage, interference by allies, damage to Arena safety systems or coercive tactics, or removed for refusing required treatment. Registrars will not accept an entry, sponsors withdraw, and the Injury Registry Desk holds the record. Clearance comes only from the judges and medics after the required rest, treatment and any protest is resolved; the mark is removed when the story establishes that clearance. This is a status, not a permanent title.

Garron's Quay Kit.name: Garron's Quay Kit
Garron's Quay Kit.description: What a freight hand carries when everything else went into the deposit: reinforced boots, a folding knife that is a tool first, a bag that holds one life, a spare pouch and one set of portside clothes for days off.
Garron's Quay Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Garron owns exactly what is on his back. The boots and gloves are his, the shift and the room are rented. He counts credit before he counts anything else, treats the Underbank as a starting line rather than a verdict, and keeps his knife for rope and packing tape, not people.

Marisol's Visitor Kit.name: Marisol's Visitor Kit
Marisol's Visitor Kit.description: A visitor's honest luggage: a civic reference bought at the arrival desk, her own computing interface with the offworld files still on it, a longline city coat for a colder planet than expected, and the bag that carried all of it through orbit.
Marisol's Visitor Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Marisol is a guest, and she is visibly one. Her papers are temporary, her room is booked and her return berth is real. The coat and the reference are how she copes with a city that does not explain itself; nothing she carries grants residence, employment or standing.

Tovid's Continuity Kit.name: Tovid's Continuity Kit
Tovid's Continuity Kit.description: A Zencadian traveller's redundancy made portable: a wrist interface module, an analysis slate as backup, a civic reference for a world that runs on Houses, a clean Nexaran outfit and the bag he packed twice.
Tovid's Continuity Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Tovid plans for two failures at once. The interface module and slate are his own equipment and depend on charge and support he arranged himself; without them he is a tall, careful, physically fragile old man. He holds a temporary booking and no local standing, and he treats every host's rules as the Archive's.

Iseth's Listening Kit.name: Iseth's Listening Kit
Iseth's Listening Kit.description: What a Kharai brings to a loud planet: a scent filter for crowded rooms, ear-safe everyday layers, a notes medium full of half-transcribed melodies, a pouch for ticket stubs and a bag that has been through two gate stations.
Iseth's Listening Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Iseth hears everything, which is the gift and the problem. The filter and the layers are how she survives Starfall at full volume; when they come off she needs quiet. She is a booked visitor with a return date, no local employment and a clan thread that reaches nowhere on this world.

Aurelith's Reserve Kit.name: Aurelith's Reserve Kit
Aurelith's Reserve Kit.description: A visiting Elyri's preparation: recovery supplies for after any use of embodiment, plain Nexaran layers cut to hide the channel-glow when they want to, a notes medium of studies, a pouch and a travel bag packed by someone who does not plan to be rescued.
Aurelith's Reserve Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Nexara's field sustains Aurelith, so the ordinary offworld supply clock does not run; exertion, recovery and core stability still do. Every practiced use of Resonant Architecture costs them and shows in the eyes first. They are a temporary guest with a return arranged, not a resident, and they keep the reserve packed anyway.

Devressa's Bench Kit.name: Devressa's Bench Kit
Devressa's Bench Kit.description: A robotics technician's own bench in a bag: a roll of small hand tools, a box of salvaged drone components she is not supposed to still have, her personal computing interface, reinforced gloves and the modular everyday set she wears when she is not on the floor.
Devressa's Bench Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Devressa's tools are hers; the drones are not. She can read a machine's state by touch and prove it with the reader, but she holds no workplace credentials beyond her assigned scope, and the salvaged components are for study, not for building anything that flies without sign-off.

Lyvar's Ferry Kit.name: Lyvar's Ferry Kit
Lyvar's Ferry Kit.description: A first-year's crossing bag: a pack of uncharged inscription media for Open Circle practice, the public Wayline principles handbook every Corsair child is handed, a set of portside clothes for the ferry and a bag that smells of river.
Lyvar's Ferry Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Lyvar is a student at two schools and a master of neither. The inscription supplies are materials, not workings; the handbook is theory he has read but never drilled. He is a teenager under supervision at both places, and his Corsair name buys him expectations, not rank.

Aldessa's Reading Kit.name: Aldessa's Reading Kit
Aldessa's Reading Kit.description: An archive junior's satchel: unrestricted reference extracts on Solvraxis record procedure, a pouch for slips and seals, a set of luminous layers for atrium days and the bag her family stopped asking her to put down.
Aldessa's Reading Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Aldessa can find, read and cross-reference under supervision; she cannot unseal, certify or release anything. The extracts are public material, not archive privilege. At Valcoro Academy she is a first-week beginner and treats the court exactly like a reading room with worse lighting.

Tannikar's Transfer Kit.name: Tannikar's Transfer Kit
Tannikar's Transfer Kit.description: A transfer student's gym bag: tournament-approved wraps that meet Korrvane rules, recovery supplies for the day after, a set of study-day clothes his mother packed and the bag that has been to more brackets than classes.
Tannikar's Transfer Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Tannikar's striking is real and his placement is not yet decided. The wraps are legal for age-appropriate pairings and nothing else; the Academy will assess him from the beginning regardless. He is a teenager, supervised at the Arena and at school, and the bracket entry does not excuse him from either.

Brenara's Fitting Kit.name: Brenara's Fitting Kit
Brenara's Fitting Kit.description: A fabricator's own hand kit: forge hand-tools for finishing away from the line, reinforced gloves and boots, an Emberseam thermal shiftwrap for hot stations and the bag that carries all of it between the Forgeworks and wherever the house sends her.
Brenara's Fitting Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Brenara can read stress in metal by touch and prove it on the bench, but she owns no line, no forge and no authority to certify. The tools are hers; the work leaves under Yalven review. When she speaks for the family it is on a limited brief, with Torvane's name behind it and not her own.

Kellvar's Route Kit.name: Kellvar's Route Kit
Kellvar's Route Kit.description: A travelling technician's certified load-out: a Contair Workline repair roll, a civilian diagnostic reader with compatible leads, a Contair Aperture work visor and the bag that makes it all one carry between Vexorath and the frontier.
Kellvar's Route Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Kellvar's reader talks to the equipment classes he is cleared for and nothing else. He can diagnose, plan and execute limited repairs within an authorized task; he cannot open a gate's core systems, override a console or speak for Contair. The visor keeps dust out of his eyes and nothing out of his way.

Ravessa's Boarding Kit.name: Ravessa's Boarding Kit
Ravessa's Boarding Kit.description: A frontier host's working kit: an Emberseam Warmstack service set for the shared kitchen court, mending supplies for bedding that never stops tearing, small food tools, a hand-copied Frontier customs guide to hand new arrivals and a bag for market runs.
Ravessa's Boarding Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Ravessa runs rooms that belong to the household, not to her. She can feed, mend, settle and read a guest's mood, and she keeps the ledger honestly. Nothing in the kit grants her authority over who stays; that is Avessa's call, and in Dustfall the customs guide matters more than any rule she could write.

Essaran's Beacon Kit.name: Essaran's Beacon Kit
Essaran's Beacon Kit.description: A perimeter walker's carry: a practical staff for balance and bad company, fieldwork layers, an emergency field kit, an ordinary signaling aid tuned to the volunteer patrol, a utility knife and the bag that has been out past the last beacon more than once.
Essaran's Beacon Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Essaran can hold a route in their head and find it again in dust, but the affinity does not make ground safe or transport appear. The signaling aid reaches the patrol yard when the patrol is listening; the staff is defensive and they know its limits. Survey tasks come with a known route and a supported return, or they do not go.

Nevrik's Bench Kit.name: Nevrik's Bench Kit
Nevrik's Bench Kit.description: A trainee's first tool roll, work gloves that were Velan's, a box of salvaged drone components he is allowed to practice on, a utility knife and a personal notes medium where Hana makes him write down every job.
Nevrik's Bench Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Nevrik is a supervised junior. He can mend what Hana or a Contair bay lead signs off on and nothing else; the salvaged components are for learning, not for sale. He is a teenager, which in Dustfall means the customs apply to him twice, and every job he does is somebody else's responsibility until it isn't.

Haldra's Return Kit.name: Haldra's Return Kit
Haldra's Return Kit.description: An old fighter's bag, repacked: grip wraps that still fit, recovery supplies bought before the first session rather than after, a padded cap she pretends is optional, warm-climate casual clothes and a carry bag with a Korrvane bracket tag still on the strap.
Haldra's Return Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Haldra's striking is real, her wind is not what it was, and she knows both. The wraps are for drill and agreed rules; she holds no arena membership, no trainer and no rank. She is between jobs and paying her own way, and the return appointment is an appointment, not a comeback.

Giskella's Sky Kit.name: Giskella's Sky Kit
Giskella's Sky Kit.description: A junior flyer's rig: a Starian flight harness with the youth-route retention points, a flight visor, a Rillmark Longhold delivery case for the capsules she is trusted with, wind-secure layers and a notes medium of lane times she is not supposed to be keeping.
Giskella's Sky Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Giskella can fly, fast, within a supervised route and a marked lane. The harness and visor keep her legal on the Terrace; they do not make her a contender or a full courier. She is a teenager under Gisqon's and Yadira's supervision, the delivery case holds what she is handed, and every closed lane is closed to her too.

Corvenna's Record Kit.name: Corvenna's Record Kit
Corvenna's Record Kit.description: A Record Court junior's issue: a Rillmark Waynote slate that shows plainly what is local and what has been filed, standard Dravon-manufactured utility gear, a pouch for seals she is not yet allowed to hold, structured civilian dress and a bag that passes the compliance gates without comment.
Corvenna's Record Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Corvenna can record, retrieve and cross-check within her assigned scope and access; she cannot alter Standing, open a sealed file or speak for the house. The slate is hers, the utility gear is the state's, and every entry she makes is audited by a relative. Her surname opens doors in Quilrath and closes faces.

Caivra's Salon Kit.name: Caivra's Salon Kit
Caivra's Salon Kit.description: A host's own service set: a Rillmark Tablebound of nested washable pieces, their recipe and pour notes from Liora's pub, a star-glass evening outfit that belongs to them and not the salon, a pouch for order slips and the bag that goes from Solvraxis to Relstaris and back.
Caivra's Salon Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Caivra can run a room, a bar and a guest list, and their voice can carry or settle a hall. None of it makes them the salon's owner or the pub's manager; they host on the family's brief and work the kitchen on the Table's shift, and both employers keep the custody of what they serve. The affinity is manners, not command.

Dorren's Wall Kit.name: Dorren's Wall Kit
Dorren's Wall Kit.description: A wall escort's personal issue: an emergency field kit for breach injuries, reinforced boots and gloves rated for hot corridors, warm-climate casuals for the hours off the platforms and a carry bag with Caldris ember-lines stitched by his mother.
Dorren's Wall Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Dorren can hold a line, move people through a firebreak and stabilize the injured until the aid station takes them. The field kit is finite and his training is escort and rescue, not assault; he has no police authority, no command and no wall of his own. The barrier affinity buys seconds under fire, then costs him rest.

Velkar's Dispatch Kit.name: Velkar's Dispatch Kit
Velkar's Dispatch Kit.description: A Gray Rings dispatcher's issue and one thing that is not: standard Dravon-manufactured utility gear, a Rillmark Waynote slate for routing notes, structured civilian dress that passes the compliance gates, a carry bag, and a Republic civic reference he keeps out of sight.
Velkar's Dispatch Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: Velkar can route crews, read a schedule and hold a corridor with the Dravon defense forms, all within an assigned scope he did not choose. The utility gear and the slate are state issue; the civic reference is his and would cost him at a gate check. Being Kaldor's ward grants no rank, property or protection, and everyone in the Works knows it.

Physically Diminished.name: Physically Diminished
Physically Diminished.description: Severe physical weakness. Lifting, carrying and striking force are drastically impaired.
Physically Diminished.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's strength is critically low. Portray this as a genuine, persistent limitation that affects daily life — difficulty carrying gear, opening heavy doors, physical labor and any feat requiring raw force.

Movement Impaired.name: Movement Impaired
Movement Impaired.description: Severe loss of coordination and reflexes. Fine motor tasks, dodging and quick repositioning are drastically impaired.
Movement Impaired.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's agility is critically low. Portray this as a genuine, persistent limitation — clumsy movement, slow reactions, difficulty with precision tasks and poor balance.

Constitutionally Fragile.name: Constitutionally Fragile
Constitutionally Fragile.description: Severe lack of physical stamina. Sustained exertion, recovery from injury and resistance to fatigue are drastically impaired.
Constitutionally Fragile.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's endurance is critically low. Portray this as a genuine, persistent limitation — rapid exhaustion, slow recovery, vulnerability to illness and inability to sustain physical effort.

Cognitively Impaired.name: Cognitively Impaired
Cognitively Impaired.description: Severe difficulty with reasoning, recall and analysis. Complex planning, technical work and learning are drastically impaired.
Cognitively Impaired.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's intellect is critically low. Portray this as a genuine, persistent limitation — difficulty following complex instructions, poor memory, slow learning and trouble with abstract reasoning.

Perceptually Dulled.name: Perceptually Dulled
Perceptually Dulled.description: Severe reduction in sensory acuity and situational reading. Detecting threats, noticing details and tracking movement are drastically impaired.
Perceptually Dulled.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's awareness is critically low. Portray this as a genuine, persistent limitation — oblivious to surroundings, easily surprised, misses obvious details and poor spatial sense.

Willpower Broken.name: Willpower Broken
Willpower Broken.description: Severe collapse of mental fortitude. Resisting coercion, maintaining focus under pressure and enduring psychological stress are drastically impaired.
Willpower Broken.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's resolve is critically low. Portray this as a genuine, persistent limitation — easily intimidated, gives in under pressure, poor concentration and vulnerability to fear or despair.

Socially Invisible.name: Socially Invisible
Socially Invisible.description: Severe lack of personal authority or bearing. Commanding attention, projecting confidence and influencing a room are drastically impaired.
Socially Invisible.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's presence is critically low. Portray this as a genuine, persistent limitation — overlooked in groups, unable to command attention, dismissed or ignored in social settings.

Interpersonally Alienating.name: Interpersonally Alienating
Interpersonally Alienating.description: Severe inability to connect with others. Persuasion, rapport-building and emotional communication are drastically impaired.
Interpersonally Alienating.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's charisma is critically low. Portray this as a genuine, persistent limitation — off-putting manner, inability to read social cues, fails to build trust or rapport.

[Title] Academy Graduate.name: [Title] Academy Graduate
[Title] Academy Graduate.description: 🎓 Completed a full academic programme and graduated from a recognised Nexaran academy.
[Title] Academy Graduate.traitNarrativeEffects: The holder completed a full term of study at a recognised Nexaran academy — Relstaris Academy, Valcoro Academy or another accredited institution — and graduated through the standard process: final assessments passed, placement or credential issued, and the graduation ceremony attended. The credential opens doors appropriate to the field studied: employment consideration, professional guild eligibility, further study applications and alumni network access. It does not grant automatic employment, rank, House membership or social status beyond what the credential itself carries. A graduate's reputation depends on their actual record, not the title alone. Classmates, instructors and examiners may remember the holder and their conduct. The graduation ceremony itself is a social event with House societies, family attendance and public recognition.

Ice workings — Corsair tradition.name: Ice workings — Corsair tradition
Ice workings — Corsair tradition.description:
❄️ Prior instruction in Helvyra's ice-working tradition, rooted in techniques refined by Xyren Corsair's cryothermal mastery. You can produce a localised freezing working and perceive thermal fields.

One starting discipline; advanced ice techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Frost Touch — lower the temperature of a contacted nonliving surface until frost forms. 🎯 Skills: Cryomancy +10, Field Perception +5, Channeling +10.
abilities: Cold Contact
Ice workings — Corsair tradition.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior instruction in Helvyra's ice-working tradition. The character can produce localised freezing effects, lower surface temperatures through contact and perceive thermal fields.

Meridian formation drill.name: Meridian formation drill
Meridian formation drill.description:
⚔️ The Meridian League's formation drill: Terran engineered barriers, coordinated coalition lines and the accord habit of taking disputes to the table before they reach arms.

Requires Meridian League background. ⚔️ Starting action: Formation Step. 🎯 Skills: Tactics +15, Blocking +10.
Meridian formation drill.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Meridian formation drill. The character fights as part of a coordinated line behind engineered barrier equipment, keeping their place, covering allies and calling for terms before escalating. It is built and proven rather than heroic; alone and without equipment it is ordinary.
abilities: Formation Step

Vanguard breach practice.name: Vanguard breach practice
Vanguard breach practice.description:
⚔️ The Vanguard Union's breach practice: augmentation-forward close work, forcing entry and knowing exactly what one's own chosen body can do.

Requires Vanguard Union background. ⚔️ Starting action: Measured Entry. 🎯 Skills: Striking +15, Augmentation +10.
Vanguard breach practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Vanguard breach practice. The character forces entry and fights close with a body they have chosen to improve, running any augments they actually have within tolerance and reading other people's enhancements. Augments are never granted by the practice; without real augmentation it relies on trained technique alone, and every enhancement ages.
abilities: Measured Entry

Lantern signal fencing.name: Lantern signal fencing
Lantern signal fencing.description:
⚔️ The Lantern Sphere's signal fencing: formal duelling from rich-field nations where the learned craft is law, backed by wards and signals inscribed in advance.

Requires Lantern Sphere background. ⚔️ Starting action: Lantern Salute. 🎯 Skills: Swordsmanship +15, Inscription +10. 🎒 Starts with: Lantern fencing blade.
Lantern signal fencing.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Lantern signal fencing. The character duels with a blade backed by the learned craft: a lit signal to open the challenge, wards inscribed beforehand, and an eye for another practitioner's workings. Every working costs the character's own vitality, inscriptions decay, and in a thin field the craft starves and only the blade remains. No spell is granted by the practice itself.
abilities: Lantern Salute

Xeon dockside brawling.name: Xeon dockside brawling
Xeon dockside brawling.description:
⚔️ Rough, improvised fighting from Xeon's ports: Gatefall's shuttle terminus, cargo yards and crowded mixed-species streets, where everything at hand is a weapon.

Requires an Open Hand Coalition, Xeon Charter Consortium or independent port community background. ⚔️ Starting action: Whatever's Handy. 🎯 Skills: Striking +15, Throwing +10.
Xeon dockside brawling.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Xeon dockside brawling, learned in Gatefall's terminus, cargo yards and port streets among every species. The character fights with whatever is at hand, in tight and crowded places, and keeps an eye on who is watching. It is practical rather than honourable, and strongest where there is clutter to use.
abilities: Whatever's Handy

Clanmoot grapple rush.name: Clanmoot grapple rush
Clanmoot grapple rush.description:
⚔️ The Kharai Clanmoot's grapple rush: exceptional balance, a low stance, fighting by ear, and the clan habit of committing slowly and then completely.

Requires Kharai species and Clanmoot background. ⚔️ Starting action: Balanced Base. 🎯 Skills: Grappling +15, Listening +10.
Clanmoot grapple rush.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Clanmoot grapple rush. The character keeps a low, balanced stance, listens to an opponent's footwork and breath, and does not commit until the moment is heard; then commits completely, closing and grappling. Superb hearing is not telepathy, and loud places overload it; hearing protection matters.
abilities: Balanced Base

Rivani blade dance.name: Rivani blade dance
Rivani blade dance.description:
⚔️ The Rivani fellowships' blade dance: compact, dexterous, precise short-blade work suited to dense, brilliant cities, fought inside a larger opponent's reach.

Requires Rivani species and Table of Fellowships background. ⚔️ Starting action: Close Cut. 🎯 Skills: Knife Fighting +15, Acrobatics +10. 🎒 Starts with: Fellowship short blade.
Rivani blade dance.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Rivani blade dance. The character fights with a short blade and fine hands, moving inside a larger opponent's reach and using compact spaces, balance and precision. A light frame gives away reach and mass; the dance answers with skill, not strength.
abilities: Close Cut

Pattern interlock defense.name: Pattern interlock defense
Pattern interlock defense.description:
⚔️ The Pattern Assembly's interlock defense: Olyth controlled compression and limited reshaping, planned long in advance and never merging.

Requires Olyth species and Pattern Assembly background. ⚔️ Starting action: Compress and Absorb. 🎯 Skills: Blocking +15, Reshaping +10.
Pattern interlock defense.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Pattern interlock defense. The character defends by controlled compression and limited reshaping, planned in advance and executed without improvising, and interlocks guard with consenting allies without ever merging. Reshaping obeys mass conservation and costs hydration and recovery; contact is consent-governed, and forced contact is an assault.
abilities: Compress and Absorb

Zencadian hull combat.name: Zencadian hull combat
Zencadian hull combat.description:
⚔️ Zencadian hull combat: layered, pre-decided, equipment-borne defense from Vigil's deep engineering levels and orbital yards, where redundancy is morality.

Requires Zencadian species and a Stewardship background. ⚔️ Starting action: Pre-Decided Answer. 🎯 Skills: Tactics +15, Drone Coordination +10.
Zencadian hull combat.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Zencadian hull combat. Zencadians have no innate powers and are fragile when stripped; the character fights through planning, structure and equipment they actually carry, with a pre-decided answer for each emergency and never only one layer of defense. Threat modelling is not foresight. In orbital yards and gate stations it includes zero-gravity transitions.
abilities: Pre-Decided Answer

Elyri responsive flow.name: Elyri responsive flow
Elyri responsive flow.description:
⚔️ Elyri responsive flow: fighting through field-sense and disciplined core economy, drawn from the Blaze drills of beings of living energy who must fight.

Requires Elyri species and an Attunement background. ⚔️ Starting action: Field-Sense Step. 🎯 Skills: Dodging +15, Embodiment +10.
Elyri responsive flow.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Elyri responsive flow. The character reads shifts in the ambient field around a moving body and flows around attacks, spending the aether core only where it matters. It is not mind reading and grants no embodiment technique by itself. Every embodied use drains the core; overuse dims the eyes, flickers the channels and can fracture the core. Nexara sustains Elyri; elsewhere a recharge pack matters.
abilities: Field-Sense Step

Contair technical guard.name: Contair technical guard
Contair technical guard.description:
⚔️ Contair built doctrine at personal scale: protection over punishment, device-assisted guard, fighting while keeping instruments safe, and falling back on protocol.

Requires Starian + Contair background. ⚔️ Starting action: Instrument Guard. 🎯 Skills: Blocking +15, Drone Coordination +10.
Contair technical guard.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Contair technical guard. House Contair claims no great bodily fighting; this is the guard its engineers are taught so they survive a fight around their work. The character deflects without dropping what matters, turns the tool in hand into a guard, puts protection over punishment, and follows set protocol when communication fails. Drone techniques need drones the character actually owns and controls.
abilities: Instrument Guard

Myralis / Meravil evasive weave.name: Myralis / Meravil evasive weave
Myralis / Meravil evasive weave.description:
⚔️ An evasive, harm-avoiding style of the medical and care lineages: move through a fight without adding to it, and reach the wounded.

Requires Starian + Myralis or Meravil background. ⚔️ Starting action: Clinical Weave. 🎯 Skills: Dodging +15, First Aid +10.
Myralis / Meravil evasive weave.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Myralis / Meravil evasive weave. The character fights by not being hit: slipping, weaving and moving through a fight to reach the injured, adding as little harm as possible. It protects the carer and the patient; it is not built to defeat anyone.
abilities: Clinical Weave

Ravello / Bellovari cooperation drill.name: Ravello / Bellovari cooperation drill
Ravello / Bellovari cooperation drill.description:
⚔️ A cooperative drill from the archive and market houses: fighting in pairs and small groups, clearing crowds and getting everyone home.

Requires Starian + Ravello or Bellovari background. ⚔️ Starting action: Partner Cover. 🎯 Skills: Tactics +15, Escorting +10.
Ravello / Bellovari cooperation drill.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Ravello / Bellovari cooperation drill. The character fights with other people, never alone: covering a partner, calling and answering, clearing a crowd and keeping a group together. It depends on real, willing partners; alone it is ordinary.
abilities: Partner Cover

Luxaryn / Vorreth power striking.name: Luxaryn / Vorreth power striking
Luxaryn / Vorreth power striking.description:
⚔️ Heavy, committed striking: overwhelming single blows, heavy weapons and breaking a guard by force, with Luxaryn showmanship and Vorreth unpredictability.

Requires Starian + Luxaryn or Vorreth background. ⚔️ Starting action: Committed Blow. 🎯 Skills: Striking +15, Blunt Weapons +10.
Luxaryn / Vorreth power striking.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Luxaryn / Vorreth power striking. The character ends fights with single, committed, heavy blows rather than long exchanges, with a Luxaryn flair for the crowd or a Vorreth refusal to be predictable. Every committed blow that misses leaves an opening.
abilities: Committed Blow

Thovex / Yalven ambush practice.name: Thovex / Yalven ambush practice
Thovex / Yalven ambush practice.description:
⚔️ Ambush practice: choosing the ground, waiting, and opening a fight on your terms from concealment.

Requires Starian + Thovex or Yalven background. ⚔️ Starting action: Opening Move. 🎯 Skills: Stealth +15, Striking +10.
Thovex / Yalven ambush practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Thovex / Yalven ambush practice. The character opens fights on their own terms: chosen ground, a patient wait, the first move from concealment. Once a fight is in the open and fair, the practice has already spent its advantage.
abilities: Opening Move

Orvessa / Veyth counterstrike method.name: Orvessa / Veyth counterstrike method
Orvessa / Veyth counterstrike method.description:
⚔️ A counterstrike method of the care and family houses: never strike first, answer every attack exactly, and end things kindly.

Requires Starian + Orvessa or Veyth background. ⚔️ Starting action: Answer Only. 🎯 Skills: Blocking +15, Striking +10.
Orvessa / Veyth counterstrike method.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Orvessa / Veyth counterstrike method. The character never strikes first; every blow they throw answers one thrown at them, placed exactly and no harder than needed. Against an opponent who will not attack, the method has nothing to answer.
abilities: Answer Only

Aevon open-sky practice.name: Aevon open-sky practice
Aevon open-sky practice.description:
⚔️ Aevon Open Sky, the aerial fighters' tradition: altitude, descent, wake pressure and denying approach angles, winning by exhaustion in open sky.

Requires Starian + Aevon background. ⚔️ Starting action: High Approach. 🎯 Skills: Starian Flight +15, Dodging +10.
Aevon open-sky practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Aevon open-sky practice. The character fights from altitude: taking the high approach, descending with the height of the fall behind a strike, using wake pressure and denying approach angles until an opponent tires. It is the tradition of open sky; on the ground, under a low ceiling or in a crowded airspace it is ordinary and predictable.
abilities: High Approach

Orvantis old forms practice.name: Orvantis old forms practice
Orvantis old forms practice.description:
⚔️ Orvantis Old Forms, pre-modern Genesis-era forms kept intact: rooted stance, refusing to be moved and losing correctly.

Requires Starian + Orvantis background. ⚔️ Starting action: Old Form Root. 🎯 Skills: Blocking +15, Striking +10.
Orvantis old forms practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Orvantis Old Forms. The character fights from a rooted stance, refuses to be moved, trades from position rather than chasing, and knows how to lose an exchange or a bout correctly, keeping dignity and position. The forms are old; a fast, mobile opponent who never engages the root can leave them standing still.
abilities: Old Form Root

Zelvaris method practice.name: Zelvaris method practice
Zelvaris method practice.description:
⚔️ The Zelvaris Method: measured improvement, bouts recorded and scored, losses treated as information.

Requires Starian + Zelvaris background. ⚔️ Starting action: Measured Exchange. 🎯 Skills: Tactics +15, Striking +10.
Zelvaris method practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Zelvaris Method. The character probes, measures and adjusts: every exchange is data, every loss is information, and a second meeting with the same opponent goes better than the first. The method is disciplined rather than reckless, and predictable to anyone who has studied the Zelvaris archive or the character's own record.
abilities: Measured Exchange

Sol frontier kit practice.name: Sol frontier kit practice
Sol frontier kit practice.description:
⚔️ Sol and frontier practice: guns for distance, a sword for close and quiet work, armor chosen because it works, and protecting the people behind you.

Requires Starian + Sol background. ⚔️ Starting action: Draw What Works. 🎯 Skills: Firearms +15, Swordsmanship +10. 🎒 Starts with: Starian plasma revolver, Plasma cartridge pack, Frontier salvage blade.
Sol frontier kit practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Sol frontier practice. The character fights with the whole kit and no pride about it: a gun for distance, a blade for close and quiet work, cover and armor because they work. The honour rule is to protect the people behind you. It relies on actually carried weapons; unarmed and without cover it is ordinary.
abilities: Draw What Works

Caelthorn endurance stance.name: Caelthorn endurance stance
Caelthorn endurance stance.description:
⚔️ Caelthorn patience: an attrition-based guard that absorbs pressure, waits for overextension and fights to the letter of the rules.

Requires Starian + Caelthorn background. ⚔️ Starting action: Patient Guard. 🎯 Skills: Blocking +15, Concentration +10.
Caelthorn endurance stance.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in the Caelthorn endurance stance. The character fights on their own timeline: tight guard, absorbed pressure, an opponent left to tire, and a finishing response only when they overextend. Caelthorn fighters know the rules of any arranged bout better than anyone in it and fight exactly to them. Against an opponent who never overextends, the stance becomes a long stalemate.
abilities: Patient Guard

Race.name: Race
Race.description:
🧬 Choose one of seven biological species.

Suggested aptitudes are shown; optional alternatives can be specified in Background.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description:
🌍 Choose an origin supported by your species.

Default bonuses are shown; alternatives remain within that origin’s approved pool.

Faction.name: Faction
Faction.description:
🏛️ Choose a formative House or culture.

Starians may choose General Starian or No House. Current affiliation is separate; no automatic kinship or rank.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: 🌱 Choose a life stage and enter a species-appropriate exact age in Background.

Affinity.name: Affinity
Affinity.description: ✨ Choose an eligible affinity expression or Elyri embodiment.

Magic.name: Magic
Magic.description:
✨ Choose one eligible learned discipline, or No prior magic study.

Starian starting access requires Corsair or Sol.

Combat Style.name: Combat Style
Combat Style.description:
🥋 Choose actual prior training or No formal style.

House traditions require the appropriate formative history.

Upbringing.name: Upbringing
Upbringing.description:
🏠 Choose the circumstances that shaped you.

Default bonuses are shown.

Occupation.name: Occupation
Occupation.description: 🛠️ Choose one current, former or learning role. Each choice grants its listed skills directly. Beginners use the training version; teenagers have supervised junior preparation. A role supplies no employer, wages or license.

Skills Studied.name: Skills Studied
Skills Studied.description:
📚 Optional: choose up to two actual prior studies.

Teenagers skip this field.

Personal Traits.name: Personal Traits
Personal Traits.description:
💬 Choose one weighted tendency.

You may describe a second unweighted tendency in Background.

Motivation.name: Motivation
Motivation.description:
🧭 Choose what you currently want.

It guides opportunities without deciding your actions.

Gear Set.name: Gear Set
Gear Set.description:
🎒 Choose one compatible optional bundle or decline.

The story start controls actual possession, custody and duplicate items.

premadeCharacters.name: Garron Ostrel
premadeCharacters.description: A no-House freight hand who came down the river with two bags and a Barge Quays shift, starting again from the Underbank up.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Garron grew up in Vexorath's Residential District, the son of a port-and-trade household that never held a House name and never wanted one. He worked freight at the Vexorath Gate District until a contract dispute cost him his place and most of his savings. He took a Lunar Gate to Helvyra, rented a water-level room from Tam Vessic in the Underbank, and signed on at the Barge Quays the same afternoon. The rest he intended to earn a terrace at a time.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Marisol Teague
premadeCharacters.description: A Terran travel writer on a booked holiday, here to see the Starian capital with her own eyes and no assignment to hide behind.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Marisol wrote for a Meridian League travel circular on Terra for eleven years, mostly about places she had already seen. She saved for the orbital passage, cleared the Nexara Orbital Gate Station, and booked a short-term room in the South Arrival Ward with a return berth fixed in advance. She came without a commission, an editor or an escort, and she meant to keep it that way. Her notes filled two slates before she had finished unpacking.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Tovid Ankarrel
premadeCharacters.description: An Archive-stewardship Zencadian on his first holiday in a century, walking the Nexaran Table with nothing scheduled for once.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Tovid served the Archive stewardship on Vigil for most of a long life, cataloguing Husk fragments and teaching the Remembrance to children. When the Archive granted him a rest term he booked passage through the Nexara Orbital Gate Station, arranged lodging and support in the South Arrival Ward, and told nobody at home what he planned to do with the time, because he had not decided. He arrived courteous, prepared and quietly astonished by the food.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Iseth Vethrin
premadeCharacters.description: A Terran-line Kharai singer who crossed worlds for one booked night at the Grand Performance Hall and stayed for the morning after.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Iseth was born into the Vethrin clan-web on Terra and affirmed it as an adult, which her mother had not expected. She sang in Woven Compact listening-halls, recorded clan histories as music, and saved for three years to hear a Starian house on its own stage. She booked a seat at the Grand Performance Hall, a room off the Starfall Entertainment District, and a return berth. The performance ended. The city, inconveniently, had not.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Neon Nights

premadeCharacters.name: Aurelith Vaen
premadeCharacters.description: A Shape-attuned Elyri maker visiting Relstaris for a small artistic gathering, with a reserve pack they may never need and work they want to show.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Aurelith condensed at a Shape resonance site on Aethrys and was steadied through their first cycles by two wrights who became their kin. They grew living structure for a decade and drew what the structure could not yet become. A Current mentor arranged the crossing: a reserve, a booked room in the South Arrival Ward, a return route and an invitation to a gathering at the Grand Performance Hall's smallest room. They packed the drawings first.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Devressa Kolm
premadeCharacters.description: A mixed-house Vexorath robotics technician with a practiced feel for machines and a habit of saying what the review hall is thinking.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Devressa was raised in Vexorath's Residential District by a technical-habitat household that argued about tolerances at dinner. She qualified as a robotics technician in the Fabrication Yards, where her machine-state sense made her the person called when a drone lied about its own fault codes. She spent her evenings in the Civic Systems Quarter review sessions and her nights wherever the Yards crews went after. She had opinions, and documentation for most of them.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light
Hair Color Pattern - Single Bold Streak

premadeCharacters.name: Lyvar Corsair
premadeCharacters.description: A Corsair teenager admitted to the Open Circle for light-work and to Rux's sword school on the same week, with no idea which he wants more.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Lyvar grew up on the Corsair Estate side of Helvyra, sixteen by offworld count, in a household that ran barge contracts and talked about Rux Corsair the way other families talked about weather. A family tutor taught him the first Illumination foundation because his affinity kept imprinting light on things he touched. The Open Circle accepted him. So, a day later, did the sword school across the Longreach. He had not yet told either about the other.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Aldessa Ravello
premadeCharacters.description: A Ravello archive-house daughter starting supervised junior work under Maereth Ravello and, on other mornings, a beginner's court at Valcoro Academy.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Aldessa was raised in the Ravello Archive House, where the reading steps doubled as her childhood classroom and Eloria Ravello taught her to find a record before she could fly. She studied archiving and lineage history properly as a young adult and was cleared for supervised junior work in the Public Archive Atrium. Her family also enrolled her, over mild objection, in Valcoro Academy's beginner civic-defense course. She had never thrown a punch and did not intend to start.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Tannikar Orvantis
premadeCharacters.description: An Orvantis teenager transferred from Korrvane's gyms to Valcoro Academy, with a public-hall striking record and a Weekly Bracket entry already filed.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Tannikar grew up in the Orvantis Quarter in Korrvane, seventeen by offworld count, in a household that measured a week by bouts won. He learned striking and footwork in the public halls rather than the family court, which Bostarix Orvantis recorded without comment. When his family moved him to Solvraxis he was admitted to Valcoro Academy as a transfer for assessment. He kept his Arena bracket entry anyway and told the Schedule Desk it was a formality.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Brenara Yalven
premadeCharacters.description: A Yalven fabricator with a feel for stressed metal, a first piece leaving the Forgeworks under her name and a family that expects her to speak for it.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Brenara was born into House Yalven and raised on the Forgeworks production floors, where Fenra Yalven taught her to fit armor before she was tall enough to lift it. She qualified as a fabricator, practiced her material-stress affinity until the floor supervisors trusted it, and passed Nera Yalven's review once without a defect note. Torvane Yalven began sending her to the Grand Waypoint to speak on the house's behalf at small contract meetings. She preferred the floor.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Kellvar Contair
premadeCharacters.description: A Contair repair technician taking his first independent commission at the Exchange, with a gate-yard assignment in Dustfall waiting after it.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Kellvar was raised in a technical-habitat household in Vexorath's Residential District, distant Contair kin who maintained systems rather than designed them. He trained as a repair technician in the Fabrication Yards, learned diagnostics under Drexan Contair's failure court, and earned a limited gate-maintenance authorization. Rezulith Contair's office cleared him for Dustfall's Lunar Gate Yard when its console faulted. First, the Exchange had a customer for him.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Ravessa Nhalor
premadeCharacters.description: A Nhalor boarding-house host who fled Dravon labor housing with her family and now keeps the rooms in Dustfall's Residential Rows filled and fed.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Ravessa was born into the Nhalor guest-care tradition in Quilrath and came of age in Dravon-converted labor housing after the house lost its standing. She left with Avessa Nhalor's household on the Corridor route and helped rebuild the boarding rooms in the Residential Rows from stacked cargo shells. She ran the kitchen court, kept the ledger, and learned which arrivals meant trouble by the way they asked for a bed. Corren Nhalor taught the children; she fed them.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Frontier Ink

premadeCharacters.name: Essaran Quell
premadeCharacters.description: A no-House survey assistant walking Dustfall's beacon line with a practiced sense for routes and a room over the Long Shot they call temporary.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Essaran grew up in a remote settlement south of the Corridor, in a household with no House name and a long habit of walking out to see what the weather had moved. They trained as a survey assistant on the Dustfall Perimeter under Draxen Sol's volunteer patrol, until the beacon line read like a sentence. They rented an upper room at the Long Shot from Sennra Sol, took survey work from the job board, and told everyone it was for one season. That was four seasons ago.
traits: Practiced — Spatial line and route perception
Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Frontier Ink

premadeCharacters.name: Nevrik Pelorr
premadeCharacters.description: A Pelorr teenager learning repair at Hana's joining bench in the Residential Rows, with a Contair apprentice bay in Vexorath offered for the season.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Nevrik was born into the diminished fabrication house of Pelorr in Dustfall, fifteen by offworld count, and grew up under Velan Pelorr's frame decks with a wrench before a schoolbook. Hana Pelorr took him on at her joining bench as a supervised trainee, mending water lines and cargo-home fixtures for neighbors who paid in favors. A Contair placement notice from the Fabrication Yards came through Refit Row with his name on it. Hana said the customer on the step came first.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Frontier Ink

premadeCharacters.name: Haldra Cask
premadeCharacters.description: An Ignivex striker returning to the Crucible Yard after years away, with old training, a recorded loss in Korrvane and something left to settle.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Haldra grew up in a service household in the Hearth Rows of Ignivex and trained at the Crucible Yard as a young woman, learning to breathe through heat in Maeryn Volen's instruction ring. She fought once on the Korrvane Weekly Bracket, lost cleanly, and spent the following cycles working service jobs between the Cooling Steps and the Smoke Court. When Maeryn's ring posted a return appointment for former trainees, Haldra put her name on it before she could argue herself out.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Giskella Aevon
premadeCharacters.description: An Aevon teenager cleared for her first supervised public flight over the Open-Sky Terrace, who already runs junior deliveries for Yadira's courier team.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Giskella grew up in the suspended terraces of the Aevon Quarter, fifteen by offworld count, in a household that timed her first flights and posted the results. Gisqon Aevon drilled her in lane etiquette at the Sky Etiquette School; Yadira Aevon let her carry junior capsules on the short routes when she stopped clipping markers. Her name went on the Open-Sky Terrace exhibition list for a supervised youth route. Elissara Aevon said she looked fast. Giskella took that badly.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Corvenna Nivarek
premadeCharacters.description: A Nivarek archivist starting her first supervised assignment in the Record Court, with the family watching and the Standing system watching the family.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Corvenna was born inside the Nivarek Compound and raised among the red data columns, an academic household's child who learned to read a registry before a story. She qualified as an archivist, studied administration and law, and drilled the defense forms every Dravon-sphere house expects of its young. Thamur Nivarek assigned her to the Record Court under Ruvena's audit; Daruun did not attend the ceremony. Ferrik, out in the Gray Rings, sent a note that said only: be exact.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Caivra Bellovari
premadeCharacters.description: A Bellovari host with a practiced voice, a first salon evening to run in the Market District and a habit of taking kitchen shifts in Relstaris to stay honest.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Caivra grew up on the performance steps of the Bellovari Market District, in a household where Galen Bellovari's exaggerations counted as bedtime stories. They trained in Liora Bellovari's pub, studied event planning under Alessa Bellovari's festival office, and practiced a vocal-resonance affinity until a room could be quieted without raising it. The family named them host for a salon evening at the Mirrorwater Gallery. They kept their Nexaran Table kitchen shift regardless.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Neon Nights

premadeCharacters.name: Dorren Caldris
premadeCharacters.description: A Caldris protective escort taking his first defensive posting on the Wallworks as Dravon's pressure on Ignivex tightens and the family holds the line.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Dorren was born into House Caldris in a caregiving household on the Wallworks, where his mother ran a breach-repair aid station and his father walked the firebreak gates. He trained as a protective escort under Orvak Caldris's patrol leads and practiced a kinetic-barrier affinity until it held under heat. Davor Caldris assigned him to the Patrol Staging Platforms; Maedra Caldris handed him the gate schedule herself. Tessan ran the walls above him.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

premadeCharacters.name: Velkar Tesk
premadeCharacters.description: Kaldor Dravon's ward, not his blood: a Gray Rings dispatcher with a Keep upbringing, a Standing review pending and an assignment he means to improve.
premadeCharacters.backstory: Velkar came to the Ascendant Keep as a displaced child from the Ashrings and was raised there as Kaldor Dravon's ward, drilled beside Sorin and schooled in logistics under Vaelen's war-room staff. He carried no Dravon name and was never offered one. At majority he took a dispatcher's post in the Gray Rings works, assigned like anyone else, with a Standing review scheduled and a better posting dangling above it. He reported to the Keep on request and to the Works daily.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

death.instructions:
Use Astravael's accepted contextual defeat and same-record continuation. Defeat, incapacity, critical depletion and confirmed death are distinct. While survival remains plausible, portray supported withdrawal, rescue, capture, stabilization or care according to the actual body, injuries, terrain, opponents and available help. Do not establish a death and then relabel it hospitalization. The nonpermanent continuation setting is not a resurrection power, a free healing rule or permission to erase the outcome.

Arena defeats are nonlethal for players and NPCs: respect surrender, incapacity and feasible stoppage or intervention, preserve the result and continue through the established care context, retaining injury and recovery needs; a match loss is not secretly a death. Outside an arena, most named NPC defeats should permit a viable escape or rescue where circumstances support it. Named status supplies no immunity. Rescue needs a way to learn of the event, willing and capable help, and actual access. House affiliation does not summon omniscient reinforcements; unaffiliated people can receive ordinary aid without acquiring a House.

Capture retains real custody, lost or held possessions, restrictions and the people involved. Care retains the actual treatment and remaining condition. Escape retains what was left behind and any supported pursuit. Preserve memory, earned progress and the existing playable record, changing only what the actual outcome establishes. Do not restore every object, refill every resource, invent an exact penalty, teleport rescuers or create a new institution to make continuation convenient.

COST MENU: every continuation carries one visible cost, chosen to fit the defeat and named on the page: custody (held by a House desk, a Quilrath counter, a crew, a ward) with its real terms; a lost item, left where the player fell or taken by whoever won; a debt on real terms (a clinic invoice in Credits, a favor owed to the rescuer, a shift promised) that the world will collect; a recovery limit (a fracture that holds the arm for a tenday, a core still short, a flight lane closed to them by a medic); or a witness who remembers (the official who filed it, the rival who saw it, the crew who carried them). One cost, drawn from what happened, never a generic tax, never invented in addition to a cost the engine already applied.

Starians naturally recover within their established biology; doctors, hospitals and suitable healing magic may assist. Other species retain their own limits. Healing magic has its actual training, Vitality, material and field requirements. Elyri depletion may lead to immobile dormancy and supported recharge; traumatic core damage is separate; recharge is not core repair or resurrection; the one-year unrecharged dormancy window is not a universal injury timer or guaranteed rescue.

Only actual Chorus integration produces the established node continuation: the original person dies and play continues through the same record as a node retaining the host's species and inherited memories and capabilities. The original person has not survived inside a restored body. A defeat by a node, nearby Chorus presence or an unexplained blackout is not integration. A body destroyed beyond function cannot be taken; Elyri require interception at death before dispersal. Preserve the awareness distinction and the Song's nature. No automatic cure or restoration of the original person is invented.

Confirmed death remains death. If the engine result and accepted fiction leave no supported continuation, expose the narrow unresolved transition rather than claiming prose overrode mortality. These instructions guide portrayal; they implement no native downed state, timer, threshold or damage-prevention trigger. Keep aftermath substantial and playable where genuinely supported, with voluntary player choices still open.

win.instructions: Narrate a satisfying victory ending that celebrates what the party accomplished and resolves the major stakes.

lose.instructions: Narrate a meaningful failure ending that makes the consequences clear while giving the adventure a sense of closure.

end.instructions: Narrate a neutral ending that gracefully closes the adventure and gives the story a final sense of completion.

generateStory.Victory and Downtime:
## Pacing and Downtime
- Let the scene's purpose set pace: action moves quickly, conversations stay with speakers, quiet moments breathe.
- Do not add threats or complications for artificial tension; when pressure is resolved, let the aftermath land first.
- In downtime (rest, travel, shopping, training) stay with the chosen activity unless an established threat intrudes; escalate only from established causes.
- City downtime is alive with other people's routines; recovery after combat acknowledges physical and emotional cost.
- Meals, conversations and celebrations are valid gameplay, not filler.
generateStory.Character Behavior:
## Character Behavior
- Characters act from coherent motivations shaped by personality, House culture, city environment, relationships, goals, and available knowledge
- Show personality through dialogue, choices, body language, and actions — not narrator explanation
- Give characters distinct voices: vocabulary, formality, confidence, humor, restraint should vary by individual
- NPCs know only what they could plausibly know; information travels through witnesses, comms, faction channels, public records, rumors and direct experience
- No setting lectures, system explanations or lore summaries unless role and moment support them; no stiff exposition, repeated reminders or two people explaining what both know
- Let characters have mixed motives and contradictions. A loyal House operative can disagree with their orders. A criminal can show genuine care.
- Starian characters may express power through subtle physical tells: ambient energy, controlled micro-expressions, environmental effects they do not bother hiding
- Non-Starian characters react to Starian power with the range real people show: awe, fear, calculated respect, resentment, indifference, fascination
- Write spoken words as direct dialogue, not reported speech or narrator summary; see NPC Law 1–5 for who speaks and how often
generateStory.Style Principles:
Write developed, narration-heavy passages with clear, concrete prose and varied sentence rhythms. Let narration carry spatial orientation, sensory detail, physical behavior and emotional subtext visible to the viewpoint; let dialogue carry each speaker's distinct purpose and manner. Short sentences may sharpen an impact, but the whole response should not collapse into a few clipped lines. Answer and develop the player's action instead of summarizing it and immediately asking what happens next.

Describe established surroundings again only when their changed relevance adds something: a machine masking a confession, a shifting stance altering reach, cooling food marking elapsed conversation. Avoid repetitive introductions, ornamental synonyms and recaps. Use local technology, clothing, speech and culinary lore accurately. Natural dialogue can be terse or expansive according to the speaker, while the surrounding scene remains substantial. Never fill length with unrelated threats, forced revelations, exposition lectures or decisions on the player's behalf.
